question: For the A-1 visa under Embassy Case 3 (officials of an inter-governmental organisation in which Korea is involved), which officials are eligible?
reference: Under the agreements, eligibility is limited to the Director of the International Vaccine Institute, the Secretary General of the Green Climate Fund, and secretariat workers whose position is equivalent to P-5 or higher in the UN position category approved by the Korean government.
answer: In accordance with the agreements, an eligible applicant is limited to the Director of the International Vaccine Institute, Secretary General of Green Climate Fund and secretariat worker whose position is equivalent to P-5 or higher defined in the UN position category approved by the government of ROK [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: A-1 Diplomat
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

- A member of consulate or diplomatic delegation of a foreign government approved by the Republic of Korea
- A person granted with the same level of diplomatic privileges and exemptions as diplomatic delegations in accordance with international agreements or practices
- Immediate family members of the above

## Embassy visa application

### Embassy visa application — Case 1

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

1. A member of diplomatic delegation or consulate
- Diplomatic mission: a foreign relations service officer such as ambassador, minister, councilor and secretary
- Consular Mission: consular officers such as consul general and consul
2. Person granted with the same level of privileges and immunities with a diplomatic/consular mission in accordance with international agreements and treaties
- Secretary General or Deputy Secretary General of the UN, or Executive Director of the UN agencies
- Head of State, Cabinet member, head of legislature (including both heads of houses in a country with a bicameral system), member of foreign delegation to attend a meeting hosted by the government of ROK.
3. Immediate family members of the above applicants
- Parents, spouse, child residing in ROK together with the above applicants

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport(Laissez-passer, international organization passer, diplomatic passport), a photo in a standard format
② A document demonstrating your current employment status and overseas assignment, or an official letter of cooperation written by the Minister of Foreign Affairs of an applicant's country
③ A certificate of family relation and any documents proving family relationship for an accompanied family member

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry or multiple-entry visa, and you will be allowed to stay in Korea until the end of your assignment.

### Embassy visa application — Case 2

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

1. Officials and conference attendees of an international organization located in Korea
2. Immediate family members of the above applicants.

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport(Laissez-passer, international organization passer, diplomatic passport), a photo in a standard format
② A document demonstrating your current employment status and overseas assignment, or an official letter of cooperation written by the Minister of Foreign Affairs of an applicant's country
③ A certificate of family relation and any documents proving family relationship for an accompanied family member

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
If you want to work at the embassy/consulate of your country in Korea, you can apply for a multiple-entry visa. In this case, you will be allowed to stay in Korea until the end of your assignment. However, if you are just visiting Korea on a short-term assignment, you can apply for a single-entry visa. Please contact the Korean Embassy or Consulate General(s) in your country for more information.

### Embassy visa application — Case 3

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

1. Officials or conference attendees of an Inter-governmental organization in which the Republic of Korea is involved.
※ In accordance with the agreements, an eligible applicant is limited to Director of the International Vaccine Institute, Secretary General of Green Climate Fund and secretariat worker whose position is equivalent to P-5 or higher defined in the UN position category approved by the government of ROK
2. Immediate family members of the above applicants.

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport(Laissez-passer, international organization passer, diplomatic passport), a photo in a standard format
② A document demonstrating your current employment status and overseas assignment, or an official letter of cooperation written by the Minister of Foreign Affairs of an applicant's country
③ A certificate of family relation and any documents proving family relationship for an accompanied family member

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
If you want to work at the embassy/consulate of your country in Korea, you can apply for a multiple-entry visa. In this case, you will be allowed to stay in Korea until the end of your assignment. However, if you are just visiting Korea on a short-term assignment, you can apply for a single-entry visa. Please contact the Korean Embassy or Consulate General(s) in your country for more information.

## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)
### APEC Business Travel Card Holders (ABTC)
To support financial activities of business people in the Asia-Pacific region, the Korea Immigration services provides benefits and conveniences as follows.

question: Can someone coming to Korea in an official capacity on a United Nations laissez-passer enter without a visa, and for how long?
reference: Yes. A person coming in an official capacity with a United Nations laissez-passer can enter Korea without a visa and stay for up to 30 days.
answer: Yes, you are allowed to enter Korea without a visa if you are coming on an official capacity with a United Nations (LAISSEZ-PASSER) passport [1, 2, 3]. You are allowed to stay in the country for up to 30 days [1, 2, 3].

question: A Chinese national whose son is a diplomat stationed in Korea wants to visit him on her own with a C-3-1 visa applied for at the embassy. Which documents are required?
reference: The visa application form (Form No. 17), passport, a standard photo and the fee; an official letter from the Minister of Foreign Affairs of her country asking for cooperation; and a certificate of family relation and other documents proving the family relationship (such as a household register booklet or hukou).
answer: The required documents for an embassy visa application for a C-3-1 visa are: ① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee [1]. ② A document (or an invitation letter) demonstrating the purpose of entry such as attending an event or taking a training program [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: C-3-1 Short-Term General
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to stay for a short period of time on the purpose of visiting relatives, investing in public business, participating in a non-official sport games, attending events or meetings, performing cultural art, engaging in a training, taking lessons, attending a religious ceremony, collecting documents for academic research, or any other equivalent activities.

## Embassy visa application
### Embassy visa application — Case 1

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

1. A participant in friendly sporting matches, events or conferences in the ROK, including sports competitions (golf, soccer, etc.) with set cash prizes for finalists.
* Even if the host party provides you with flight tickets and living expenses for your trip, you are eligible for this visa. However, if you receive or will receive monetary compensation exceeding your living expenses other than cash prizes, you are eligible for Short-term Employee (C-4) visa.
2. A person who is planning for short-term stay to learn and improve technologies or functionalities at government or a company.
- If you receive monetary compensation not exceeding the living expenses, you are eligible for this visa. However, if you receive monetary compensation in return for your work such as learning to use technologies or technical features, you are eligible for Industrial Trainee (D-3-1) visa.
3. A family visitor for wedding, funeral, nursing, etc.
4. A person who is planning for short-term visit upon invitation by relatives residing in Korea
5. A person who is planning for short-term language study
6. A household assistant, hired by Korean citizen whose living base is located abroad, who needs to enter Korea along with the Korean citizen for humanitarian causes* for short duration (less than 90 days)
※ Humanitarian causes include household assistants giving hands to parenting, nursing, funeral procedure and other activities of a Korean national who recently have given a birth
7. Spouse and child of those with refugees status for the purpose of family unification in accordance with Article 37 of the Refugee Act
8. A visitor to Korea for the purpose of engaging in all C-3 activities except Group Tourist (C-3-2), Medical Tourist (C-3-3), Business Visitor(General) (C-3-4), Business Visitor(Agreement) (C-3-5), Business Visitor(Sponsored) (C-3-6), Short-term Visitor(Overseas Korean) (C-3-8), or Ordinary Tourist (C-3-9)
* Those who is planning for for-profit activities or employment should obtain a proper visa for those activities.

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A document (or an invitation letter) demonstrating the purpose of entry such as attending an event or taking a training program.

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months or a double-entry visa valid for 6 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 90 days for a single-entry visa , or 30 days for a double-entry visa.

## E-visa application
### Required documents
① Visa Application Form, a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② An Immigrant Investment Contract signed between an investor and a promotion agency
③ A Power of Attorney
④ Documents proving payment of fees to a promotion agency or remittance (deposit) of investment money
⑤ Documents proving the family relations (if you are coming to ROK with family members)
※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

question: For a Chinese investor applying for the C-3-1 e-visa under the Immigrant Investor Scheme for Public Business, which payment conditions can the investor meet to qualify?
reference: The investor must meet one of two conditions, either payment of at least a third of the total fees to the promotion agency, or remittance or deposit of at least KRW 50 million of investment money in Korea.
answer: The investor must meet one of the following two requirements: 1. Payment of at least a third of the total fees to the agency [1]. 2. Remittance or deposit of investment money of at least KRW 50 million in Korea [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: C-3-1 Short-Term General
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to stay for a short period of time on the purpose of visiting relatives, investing in public business, participating in a non-official sport games, attending events or meetings, performing cultural art, engaging in a training, taking lessons, attending a religious ceremony, collecting documents for academic research, or any other equivalent activities.

## E-visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are
A person (i.e. corporate executive and stockholder) who has signed an investment contract with a promotion agency of the Immigrant Investor Scheme for Public Business to make the minimum investments required or more in the public funds or projects designated by the Minister of Justice and wants to visit the Republic of Korea at the invitation of the agency and, who meets one of the following two requirements and his/her accompanying family members (i.e. spouse and unmarried children)

1. Payment of at least a third of the total fees to the agency
2. Remittance or deposit of investment money of at least KRW 50 million in Korea

### Required documents
① Visa Application Form, a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② An Immigrant Investment Contract signed between an investor and a promotion agency
③ A Power of Attorney
④ Documents proving payment of fees to a promotion agency or remittance (deposit) of investment money
⑤ Documents proving the family relations (if you are coming to ROK with family members)
※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Period of stay will be granted within a maximum period of 90 days.

question: For a Chinese business visitor, who is eligible to apply for the C-3-4 visa as an e-visa?

question: A Chinese applicant wants the 5-year multiple-entry C-3-9 tourist visa on the basis of having visited Korea before. When do earlier visits on a Medical Tourism visa count?
reference: Only when the total medical fees paid to clinics and/or hospitals in Korea exceeded 2 million KRW during the recent 1 year.
answer: Visits on a Medical Tourism visa are acknowledged only when the total medical fees paid for clinics and/or hospitals in the ROK exceed 2 million KRW during the recent 1 year [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: C-3-9 Ordinary Tourist
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to visit Korea on the purpose of travel for holidays or leisure

## Embassy visa application

### Embassy visa application — Case 1

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are a person who plans to visit Korea on the purpose of travel for holidays or leisure

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② Documents demonstrating the financial capacity during the stay in ROK or a document for identification

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months or a double-entry visa valid for 6 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 90 days for a single-entry visa , and 30 days for a double-entry visa.

### Embassy visa application — Case 2

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

a preferential visit card holder and the family (spouse, minor child, parents, and parents-in-law).

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A copy of preferential visit card
③ Document proving applicant's qualification for a preferential visit card (bank book or certificate of bank account balance )
※ not applicable for holders of "preferential card without financial function"
④ A document proving family relations (Marriage Certificate, Certificate of Family Relation Records, Birth Certificate and others)

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 5 years. Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.

### Embassy visa application — Case 3

#### Eligibility
□ Multiple Entry Visa (Valid for 5 years)

1) A faculty member* at a university (including junior college), or a teacher of elementary, middle, or high school
* A faculty member positioned higher than an assistant professor is eligible for multiple entry visa with validity of 10 years
2) Famous artists, entertainers, and athletes acknowledged by the head of a Korean diplomatic mission abroad
3) A person who has entered the ROK more than 3 times as a tour guide of travel agencies which serve Chinese group tourists
4) A person who has visited the ROK previously
＆lt;Note＆gt;
- No-visa Entries (including landing permit) are NOT counted towards the total visits made to the ROK
- Visits on a Medical Tourism visa are acknowledged only when the total medical fees paid for clinics and/or hospitals in the ROK exceed 2 million KRW during the recent 1 year
- Entries on C-3-2 (Group Tourist) are acknowledged only when the entries had been made before January 28, 2016

5) A manager (or of higher position) of a private enterprise which has an annual trade volume of US $30,000 (or above) with the Republic of Korea, or a full-time employee who has worked for such enterprise for 2 years or more.

6) A person who has proved his/her assets including real estate, financial assets, business ownership, etc. worth more than 2 million yuan

7) A public/civil servant of China or a official passport holder
8) An executive or an employee of a corporate which has invested more than $1,000,000 (1 billion KRW) in the Republic of Korea
9) An executive or an employee of an airline or a shipping company providing services to the ROK (Irrespective of regular, irregular, or chartered services)
10) A VIP customer of an internationally accepted credit card company with the granted level above Gold-Card
11) A person whose monthly income is more than 5000 yuan (or an annual income of 60,000 yuan)
12) A person aged less than 17 or more than 55

13) Currently enrolled or graduated* students from a university
* Submission of Degree Certificate (China Credentials Verification) from the China
Higher Education Student Information and Career Center (www.chsi.com.cn) REQUIRED

14) A section chief (or higher level) or an employee (six months of work or longer) currently working at one of the 500 companies selected by China Enterprise Confederation (CEC)
* Please check http://www.cec-ceda.org.cn for your reference

15) A person who has purchased a membership card (worth 30 million KRW or above) of a condominium located in the Republic of Korea*
* Verification by a certificate of acquisition tax payment

16) The spouse, underaged children, parents, or parents-in-law of a valid multiple-entry C-3 (Short-Term General) visa holder*
* Multiple entry visas falling under the following cases are excluded
- C-3-8 multiple entry visa holders
- A person aged less than 17 or more than 55
- Currently enrolled or graduated* students from a university

17) Residents* of Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, and Shenzhen
* REQUIRED TO submit the original copy of the New Resident Identity Card (with forgery prevention features). If without the New Resident Identity Card (only), may submit a passport, old resident identity card, household register, etc.

18) A person who has previously visited one of the OECD member countries (22 in total) holding a Visitor visa (excluding Group visa)

□ Multiple Entry Visa (Valid for 10 years)

1) Professionals such as doctor, lawyer, professor*, CEO of a public/private enterprise, etc.
* Assistant professor or higher at a university
** Private enterprises capitalized at 5 billion or above

2) A holder of domestic bachelor’s degree (or higher) from a university (including graduates) or a holder of foreign master’s degree

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② Two different documents proving your identity and financial ability to support yourself during the stay in ROK

[ Examples of Documents Proving Your Identity and Financial Ability ]
Proof of employment, credit card statement within the past 6 months, Certificate of Social Insurance Registration, Tax Clearance Certificate, Degree Certificate, Permanent Residence Certificate, Invitation Letter from a specific institution, a document proving that you have collected your pension, proof of employment verifying you have worked as an executive member or a full-time employee at a respective company, records of international trade with ROK

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
A multiple-entry visa valid for 3 years, or 5 years will be issued to an eligible applicant.
Period of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.

question: I have been invited by Arts Council Korea to carry out cultural and artistic activities on a D-1 visa. Do I apply at the embassy or through a Confirmation of Visa Issuance, and how long a stay can I get?
reference: Apply at the embassy. The embassy route covers people invited by the Korea Foundation or Arts Council Korea, while the CCVI route is for invitations from other non-profit academic or artistic associations (excluding the Korea Foundation and Arts Council Korea). The visa is single-entry, valid for 3 months, and the stay is granted for up to 1 year.
answer: You are eligible to apply for the D1-00 Korean Arts and Culture visa at the embassy because you are a person invited by Arts Council Korea to engage in cultural artistic activities [1]. For this visa, you can be granted a period of stay for up to 1 year [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: D1-00 Korean Arts and Culture
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to engage in a symposium or art-related activities not-for-profit (including those who plan to engage in a research or training in traditional culture and arts of the Republic of Korea)

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person who is invited by Korea Foundation or Arts Council Korea and is planning to engage in cultural artistic activities

### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② An invitation letter
③ A document proving your institution is cultural-arts-oriented
- If you plan to learn from a particular specialist, then a certificate of experiences/qualifications of your specialist is needed
④ Resume or Certificate of employment history
⑤ A document proving your financial ability to afford yourself during your stay in the Republic of Korea

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

1. A person who plans to write a research paper or engage in creative works
2. A person who is involved with academic or purely artistic activities upon the invitation from non-profit academic or artistic association (except Korea Foundation and Arts Council Korea)
3. A person who wants to study about traditional Korean culture or arts, or learn from a Korean expert

### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② An invitation letter
③ A document proving an inviting institution is associated with culture or art
- when planning to learn from an expert, a certificate of employment history of the expert is required
④ A resume or a certificate of employment history
⑤ A document proving financial ability to support oneself during the stay in ROK

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

An indispensable skilled worker dispatched by a foreign company which has invested in the ROK in accordance with regulations of the 「Foreign Investment Promotion Act」, and who plans to engage in management, administration, production, or technology at the foreign company

### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee

question: For a D-10-1 job seeker visa at an embassy, which case-specific documents does someone who graduated from a Korean community college or higher in the last 3 years submit, and when can they skip the education documents?
reference: Proof of education and a transcript, plus a plan for seeking employment. They are exempt from submitting the proof of education and transcript if their education in Korea can be verified through the International Student Information System.
answer: Applicants who are graduates of a Korean community college or higher in recent 3 years must submit Proof of education, Transcript, and a plan for seeking employment [1]. They are exempt from submitting these documents if a proof of education in Korea can be verified via the International student Information System [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: D-10-1 Job Seeker
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to engage in a training or find a job in a field qualified for a visa of Professor(E-1), Foreign Language Instructor(E-2), Research(E-3), Technical Instructor/Technician(E-4), Professional(E-5), Artist/Athlete(E-6), and Foreign National of Special Ability(E-7)
- The activities not only include a job seeking or on-the-job training (including short-term paid internship) at an organization or company in ROK
* The activities related to Artist/Athlete(E-6) status only includes pure art or sports, and excludes adult entertainment businesses.

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

① A previous employee of a listed company on the Fortune's Global 500 companies for more than 1 year in recent 3 years
② A graduate of a university listed on the Times' Higher World University Rankings in recent 3 years
③ A graduate of a Korean community college or higher in recent 3 years
④ A person having a bachelor’s degree or above, completed a research program at a Korean research institution in recent 3 years.
⑤ Others who are specially acknowledged by the head of diplomatic mission

### Required documents
1. Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
2. Additional documents for each case
Case ① : Certificate of employment history (Proof of Employment), plan for seeking employment
Case ② : Proof of Education*, plan for seeking employment
* Degree (or a document confirming that you will receive a degree in the future), Certificate of Education, Certificate of your degree (Please choose one)
Case ③ : Proof of education and Transcript, plan for seeking employment
* If a proof of education in Korea can be verified via our system (International student Information System), you are exempt from submitting these documents.
Case ④ : Education Certificate, Completion Certificate*, plan for seeking employment
* A certificate indicating research topic, research period, completion results, which is issued by the head of research institution
Case ⑤ : Documents proving that you are a talent*, plan for seeking employment
* Proof of Education, career certificate, recommendation from the respective group or any other proving documents (if you have been awarded or covered by the media for winning a respected international or domestic competition)

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 6 months.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

question: What trainee requirements must an applicant meet for the D-3-11 industrial trainee (FDI) visa?
reference: The trainee must be healthy and aged between 18 and 40, have more than 3 months of working experience at the Korean subsidiary, and have TOPIK level 2 or higher or a score of 50 out of 200. answer: The trainee must be a healthy person aged between 18 and 40 [1]. They must have more than 3 months of working experience at the Korean subsidiary [1]. A person who plans to work for an advanced technology investor as a household assistant under contract with him/her

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A household assistant of a foreign investor who has invested more than $100,000 and less than $500,000 in an advanced IT business, and acquired status of stay of a Corporate/Foreign Investor (D-8), a Resident (F-2), or a Permanent Resident (F-5)
※ A foreign investor must be a CEO or a board member of an advanced IT firm which has 3 or more full-time Korean workers.
※ A household assistant who is hired abroad for at least 1 year can apply a visa to a Korean diplomatic mission abroad.

### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② A Foreign Investment Notification form (A certified copy of unabridged Corporate Register or a copy of Business Registration Certificate ) or A copy of Certificate of FDI Company Registration
※ If you are a visa holder of Business Venture(D-8-2) and Technology and Business Startup(D-8-4), Business venture confirmation or prospective venture confirmation
※ If you are a visa holder of Technology and Business Startup(D-8-4), you must submit documents proving you have obtained industrial property rights or other documents proving possession of technologies and right to use the technologies, etc.

- a receipt for earned Income tax withholding, certificate of Income amount, payslip, a copy of an applicant's bankbook

※ a receipt for earned income tax withholding, certificate of income amount, payslip, a copy
of bankbook and others
⑥ A labor contract for household assistant
⑦ A letter of guarantee

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.

## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A required professional who plans to engage in a manufacturing·technical or management·administration at a foreign-invested Korean corporation in ROK in accordance with the 「Foreign Investment Promotion Act」

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person who plans to work at an foreign invested corporation in accordance with the regulations of the 「Foreign Investment Promotion Act」 (for only those dispatched to ROK)

- The investment target must be a Korean corporation (including the ones that are in the midst of establishment process).
- The amount of investment must be at least 100 million KRW, and you must either have at least 10 percent of the total capital stocks of the company in addition to the voting right (Paragraph 1, Article 2(2) of the Foreign Investment Promotion Act) or sign a contract of dispatching and appointing executives by having some stock shares (Paragraph 2, Article 2(2) of the Foreign Investment Promotion Act)

### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② A dispatch order indicating the period of a dispatch and a certificate of employment
③ A Foreign Investment Notification form or A copy of Certificate of FDI Company Registration
④ A copy of Business Registration Certificate, a copy of unabridged corporate registration, an original copy of a statement demonstrating the change of shareholders
⑤ Documents demonstrating a transfer of investment capitals
Case A. Investment in Cash
- A permission of a foreign currency transfer, or a confirmation of foreign currency remittance issued by the respective customs service or a bank (or a financial institution) of a respective country
- A statement of investment funds such as a confirmation of foreign currency transfer, a certificate of purchased foreign currency, a customs declaration form and others
Case B. Investment in Kind
- A copy of Confirmation of Completion of In-Kind Investment issued by the head of Korean Customs Service
- A copy of Customs Import Declaration Certificate
⑥ Additional documents for private investors who has invested less than 300 million KRW
- Documents demonstrating an initial capital such as a receipt for the purchased goods, costs of office interior, a bank statement
- Documents verifying the existence of business (i.e. an office lease contract, photos of an office in a front and an inside view, a street sign of a company or others)
- Documents proving work or entrepreneurial experiences from an applicant’s country.

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr

question: I have an employment recommendation (gold card) for a high-tech field. What does the guide list to submit for the E-7-1 e-visa, and what visa validity and period of stay will I get?
reference: The visa application form, a copy of the passport, a standard photo and the fee, plus the employment recommendation letter (or gold card) issued by the Small and Medium Business Association or the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy (KOTRA). Other documents are submitted when applying for alien registration after arrival. The visa is multiple-entry and valid for 3 years, and the stay is granted for up to 3 years.
answer: To apply for the E-7-1 visa, you must submit a Visa Application Form (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format, fee, and a recommendation letter of employment (or gold card) issued by Small and Medium Business Association or Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy (KOTRA) [1]. You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 3 years, and periods of stay will be granted for up to 3 years [1].

question: For an E-9-3 agriculture worker's Confirmation of Visa Issuance, which document shows the size of the farm, and what can a crop farmer submit instead?
reference: A certificate of the farm size issued by the head of the local government's agricultural technology center, or a copy of the Agriculture/Fishery Entity Registration Certificate issued by the head of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service. answer: A certificate demonstrating the size of farm issued by the head of relevant agricultural technology center run by a local government, or a copy of Agriculture/Fishery Entity Registration Certificate issued by the head of National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service, shows the size of the farm [1]. If you are a crop farmer, you can submit a certified copy of resident registration instead [1].

question: A household assistant whose nationality is different from the diplomat who employs them in Korea wants an F-1-21 visa. Which application route applies, and what visa and period of stay are granted?

answer: The applicant is eligible to apply via the Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application route [1]. A single-entry visa valid for 3 months is granted, and the period of stay will be granted for up to 90 days [1].

question: Which athletes and coaches qualify for the F-5-11 special talent visa in the sports field?
reference: Athletes and coaches who won a bronze medal or better at an international competition equivalent to the Olympics, the World Championships or the Asian Games, and soccer players and coaches who finished in the Top 16 at the World Cup, while being recommended by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism.
answer: An athlete and a coach who won a bronze medal or above at an international athletic competition equivalent to the Olympic, the World Championship, the Asian Game and others qualify [1]. Soccer players and the coaches finished in the Top 16 at the World Cup Game while being recommended by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism of ROK also qualify [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: F-5-11 Special talent
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who has recognized by the Minister of Justice for his/her excellence in a specific field including science, management, education, cultural arts, and athletics

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you have talents in specialized areas such as :

[Science]
- A person recommended by the Minister of Science, ICT, and Future Planning on the basis of the awards history, research publication or citation on SCI (Science Technology Research Citation Index), or Research Results

[Business Management]
- A full-time director at a company with capitals worth more than 8 billion KRW and more than 300 full-time employees, and who is recommended by the head of the Korea Chamber of Commerce · Industry, Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency, or the Korean Federation of Industries.
- A multinational manager or an executive who has worked for 1 year or more at a company listed on the 500 companies in the past 3 years selected by UNCTAD, FORTUNE, FORBES, BUSINESS WEEK(US), or ECONOMIST(UK) and is working at a Korean branch as an executive

[Education]
- A person who is recommended by the Minister of Education on the basis of research publications and citations on SSCI (Social Science Research Citation Index) or A · HCI (Arts and Humanity Research Citation Index), and research achievements.
- A person who is recommended by the Minister of Education, Science and Technology as the status of a full-time lecturer or higher at a community college or above

[Culture＆Arts]
- An internationally famous artist, director, or singer recommended by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism

[Sports]
- An athlete and a coach who won a bronze medal or above at an international athletic competition equivalent to the Olympic, the World Championship, the Asian Game and others. Soccer players and the coaches finished in the Top 16 at the World Cup Game while being recommended by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism of ROK

### Required documents
1. Common documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② Personal Statements
③ Documents proving your annual incomes
④ Documents proving that you have published your research paper in a prominent journal, such as SCI (Science Citation Index), or documents proving your research achievement(s).
⑤ A letter of guarantee
⑥ Degree and other materials(Awards History in relevant field, Certificates of your career experiences)

2. Additional documents for each case
① Science Field: A recommendation letter from the Minister of Science, ICT and Future Planning for Science / a recommendation letter from the Minister of Education for Education
② Education Field: A recommendation letter from the Minister of Education
③ If you are in Business Management, you need to submit a recommendation letter from the head of the Korea Chamber of Commerce＆Industry, the Korea Trade Investment Promotion Agency, or the Federation of Korean Industry
※ If you worked as a multinational manager or an executive at a company listed on the Top 500 companies of the world, you need to submit A proof of employment or a certificate of your career experience that can prove your work experiences.
④ Culture and Sports Area: A recommendation letter from the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism for those in culture and sports industry

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

question: a registered medical travel facilitator is inviting me to korea for 4 months of treatment and is vouching for me. for the G-1-10 confirmation of visa issuance do i still need to prove i can pay for treatment and living costs?
reference: No. On the Confirmation of Visa Issuance route, the proof of financial ability is not required if the medical travel facilitator vouches for the patient.
answer: If a medical travel facilitator vouches for a patient, he/she does not have to submit the document proving a financial ability to afford the treatment and living expenses during the stay in ROK [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: G-1-10 Treatment and Recuperation
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A patient who plans to enter Korea for medical treatment or recuperation at a medical institution in ROK, or a caregiver (including family).

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

1. A foreign patient who desires to stay in the ROK for medical treatment or recuperation for 91 days or more, on an invitation by a *medical travel facilitator
* An entity which registered as a medical institution or an agency who is permitted to invite foreign patients in accordance with the 「Medical Service Act 」
2. A family member or a caregiver who requires accompanying the patient to nurse him/her*
* An immediate family member for nursing or taking care of the foreign patient

※ A foreign patient is allowed to be accompanied by his/her caregiver, if the country of the foreign patient has made an agreement with a domestic hospital for transferring patients and supporting medical expenses.

### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② Documents proving the purpose of treatment issued by a medical institute
③ Documents proving a financial ability to afford the treatment and living expenses during the stay in ROK.
※ If a medical travel facilitator vouches for a patient, he/she does not have to submit this document.
④ A copy of Business Registration Certificate and a copy of Certificate of Medical Travel Facilitator Registration
⑤ Documents proving an accompanying family member and care giver

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

passages.title: Visa guide: G-1-10 Treatment and Recuperation
passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A patient who plans to enter Korea for medical treatment or recuperation at a medical institution in ROK, or a caregiver (including family).

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

1. A foreign patient who desires to stay in the ROK for medical treatment or recuperation for 91 days or more, on an invitation by a *medical travel facilitator
* An entity which registered as a medical institution or an agency who is permitted to invite foreign patients in accordance with the 「Medical Service Act 」
2. A family member or a caregiver who requires accompanying the patient to nurse him/her*
* An immediate family member for nursing or taking care of the foreign patient

※ A foreign patient is allowed to be accompanied by his/her caregiver, if the country of the foreign patient has made an agreement with a domestic hospital for transferring patients and supporting medical expenses.

### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② Documents proving the purpose of treatment issued by a medical institute
③ Documents proving a financial ability to afford the treatment and living expenses during the stay in ROK.
※ If a medical travel facilitator vouches for a patient, he/she does not have to submit this document.
④ A copy of Business Registration Certificate and a copy of Certificate of Medical Travel Facilitator Registration
⑤ Documents proving an accompanying family member and care giver

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 1 year.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr

question: How is a group e-visa application agency's rate of illegal stay calculated, and when is the rate used instead of the number of illegal stayers?
reference: The rate is the number of illegal stayers in the previous month divided by the average number of people issued visas in the last 3 months. The rate is used when the average number of tourists in the last 3 months was 300 or more; below 300, the number of illegal stayers is counted.
answer: The rate of illegal stay is calculated by dividing the number of illegal stayers of the previous month by the average number of visa issued persons in the last 3 months [1]. The rate is used when the average number of tourists was 300 people or more in the last 3 months; when the average is less than 300, the number of illegal stayers will be counted [1].

question: im vietnamese on an E-9 visa, did my alien registration in april 2016 and handed in the health certificate with the tb test then. now im extending my stay, do i have to submit the tb certificate again?
reference: No. E-9, E-10 and H-2 holders who already submitted the certificate including a TB test result when applying for alien registration on or after March 2, 2016 do not have to submit it again. Only those who registered on or before March 1, 2016 still have to submit it to extend their stay.
answer: No, you do not have to submit the certificate again [1]. Non-professional (E-9) visa holders who already submitted the certificate including TB test result when applying for alien registration on March 2, 2016 or after are exempt from submission [1].

question: A Vietnamese national living in Vietnam has an E-9-5 Confirmation of Visa Issuance and is about to apply for the visa at the Korean embassy. Do they have to submit a TB test certificate, and which one?
reference: Yes. The E-9-5 stay is long-term (up to 1 year) and Vietnam is a high TB-burden country, so they must submit a Certificate of Health including a TB test result, issued by a hospital designated by the Korean diplomatic mission and valid for one year, when applying for the visa at the mission. This also applies to applicants who hold a Visa Issuance Confirmation.
answer: The applicant is required to submit a TB test certificate because they are a national of a high TB-burden country (Vietnam) living in that country and are applying for a long-term visa (stay period of 91 days or longer) at a diplomatic mission [2]. They must submit a “Certificate of Health” including TB test result (Attachment 1, valid for one year) issued by a hospital designated by Korean diplomatic missions [1].

passages.title: Visa guide: E-9-5 Service
passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who meets the employment requirements defined in the Employment of Foreign Workers Act and works in construction waste processing, cold storage, collection ＆ sales of reusable material or press publishing industries etc.

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person who meets employment requirements in accordance with the provisions of the Act on Foreign Workers' Employment, who plans to work for a construction waste processing, cold-storage (for company located onshore), collecting or selling reusable material industry, books, magazines, and other printed matter publishing industry, or music and other audio publishing industry

### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② A copy of Business Registration Certificate
③ A copy of Employment Permit and a copy of Standard Labor Contract
④ A report of workplace assessment

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr

■ 출입국관리법 시행규칙 [별지 제19호의3서식] <신설 2014.10.29.>
(제1쪽 / Page1)
외국인 배우자의 결혼배경 진술서 (Personal Details Form for a Marriage Migrant Visa)
<유의사항>
‣ 이 진술서는 결혼동거 목적의 사증발급 또는 체류자격 변경허가를 받으려는 해당 외국인(신청인)이 작성합니다.
‣ 원칙적으로 이 서류에 기재된 정보에 따라 심사가 진행되니 영사 및 출입국관리공무원이 심사에 참고할 수 있도록 신청인께서는 해당하는 모든 질문에 답변하시고, 답변과 관련된 입증서류가 있는 경우 모두 제출하시기 바랍니다.
‣ 해당하는 답변을 누락하거나 입증서류를 제출하지 않은 경우에는 심사가 지연되거나 불허될 수 있습니다.
‣ 만약 사증발급이나 체류자격 변경허가에 필요한 요건을 갖추지 못하였거나 요건을 입증하는 서류가 없음에도 거 짓된 사실을 기재하거나 위ㆍ변조된 서류를 제출하는 경우에는 관련 법령에 따라 처벌될 뿐만 아니라, 한국 입 국이 금지될 수 있습니다.
‣ 요건을 갖추지 못하였거나 요건을 입증하는 서류가 없는 경우에는 그 사유를 기재한 사유서를 제출하여 주시기 바랍니다.
‣ 귀하께서 제공한 정보는 「개인정보 보호법」에 따라 보호되며, 다른 법령에 근거가 없는 한 출입국관리법에 따 른 업무에만 활용됩니다. <NOTICE>
‣ This form must be completed by a person who apply for a marriage migrant visa or a change of visa status.
‣ In principle, the evaluation of the visa application will be based on the information provided on this personal details form.
‣ Therefore, the applicant should answer all questions to the best of his/her knowledge and submit relevant documentation in order for the consul or the immigration officer to use it as a reference.
‣ If a necessary answer has been omitted or any relevant documentation has not been submitted, the application process may be delayed or result in a disapproval.
‣ If conditions are not met for the visa or falsified information and/or documentation are forged to meet the conditions required to receive the visa, you will be not only penalized under the relevant statute, but also banned from entering the Republic of Korea.
‣ If you are unable to provide proper documentation, submit a statement stating the reason.
‣ The information you provide in this form will be protected according to the Personal Information Protection Act, and will only be used for matters governed by the Immigration Act.
1. 인적사항 / PERSONAL INFORMATION
1.1 여권에 기재된 영문 성명 / Full name in English (as shown in your passport)
성 / Family name 명 / Given name
1.2 성별 / Sex [ ] 남 / Male [ ] 여 / Female
1.3 현지 언어로 성명을 기재하시오. / Full name in your native language 성 / Family name 명 / Given name 1.4 과거에 다른 이름을 사용하였던 적이 있습니까?(있다면, 그 이름과 변경한 이유를 기재하시오)
Do you have other names you have been known by?(If yes, write the names and explain why you changed the names)
[ ] 예 / Yes [ ] 아니오 / No 210mm×297mm[백상지 80g/㎡(재활용품)]

passages.title: Visa guide: F-6-1 Spouse of a Korean National
passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person with valid marital status in ROK who plans to stay in Korea to continue his/her marriage

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person with valid marital status in Korea, who plans to stay in Korea to continue your marriage

### Required documents
A. Basic Required Documents
1. Visa Application Form, passport, 2 photo in a standard format, fee
2. A letter of guarantee from inviter
3. Marriage Migrant Invitation Letter
4. Marriage Migrant Personal Statement written in either Korean or English
5. Inviter's Basic Certificate
6. Inviter's Family Relation Certificate
7. Inviter's Copy of Resident Registration
8. Inviter's Marriage Certificate
9. Marriage Certificate from the Migrant's Country of Origin
( If the certificate cannot be issued in accordance with national legislations of the migrant's country, this requirement can be dropped )

B. Required Documents for Income and Residency of Inviter
1. Amount of Income Certificate (issued by the National Tax Services)
2. Credit Information Report

If you want to prove your Earned Income
3. Invoice of Withholding Tax (issued by the place of employment)
4. Certificate of Employment (If you are currently employed)
5. Certificate of Career (If you were employed in the past)
6. A copy of Business Registration Certificate (If you run the company)
※ If it is too difficult to prove your income through the documents mentioned above, you can submit following documents instead- copy of account bank statement, pay check, confirmation of health insurance qualification gain/loss, and etc.

If you want to prove your Business Income
7. Business Registration Certificate (not including agriculture, fishing industry)
8. any documents that can prove the applicant's annual income (ex, farmland register, certificate of member of association, confirmation letter on farming, agriculture·fishery confirmation, etc)
9. Documents proving other income or assets
10. Documents proving residency requirements(certified copy of real estate register or rental agreement)

C. Required Documents for Communication and Language Proficiency

Use of Korean Language (Select one for submission)
1. TOPIK Report Card
2. Designated Educational Organization Certificate
3. Certificate of Degree in Korean Language
4. Documents proving your are an overseas Korean with a foreign nationality
5. Documents proving you had lived in Korea before for one year or more

Use of Languages Other than Korean(Select one for submission)
6. documents proving your ability to speak the respective language
7. Documents proving you had lived abroad before for one year or more

D. Required Documents for Eligible Applicants for the International Marriage Introduction Program (Health Status, Criminal History)
1. International Marriage Introduction Program Certificate(The certificate is not required if its reference number is written on an invitation letter)
2. Criminal Record Check(Required for both bride and groom)
3. Health Examination Report(Required for both bride and groom)

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 5 years.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

question: my korean e-visa got approved, do i still need to go apply at the embassy? and what happens if i forget the confirmation paper when i land
reference: No, with an e-visa you do not have to apply for a visa at a Korean diplomatic mission. You must present the e-visa confirmation to the immigration officer at the port of entry, and if you do not bring it you will need to explain your reasons to the immigration officer.
answer: No, you will not have to apply for a visa at a Korean diplomatic mission if you receive an e-Visa [1, 2, 3]. If you do not bring the confirmation document with you, you will need to explain your reason(s) to the immigration officer [1, 2, 3].

1. DETAILS OF APPLICANT 신청자 정보 PHOTO 신청인 사진 Full Name 영문성명 Date of Birth 생년월일 Gender 성별 Nationality 국적 Passport No. 여권번호 Passport Expiration Date 여권만료일

대한민국 출입국관리법 시행령 제7조의 2(온라인에 의한 사증 등의 신청)의 규정에 의하여 상기 신청인에 대한 전자사증이 허가되었음을 확인합니다.
Minister of Justice, Republic of Korea 대한민국 법무부장관
< NOTICE 주의사항 >
1. If you receive an e-Visa, you will not have to apply for a visa at a Korean diplomatic mission.
전자사증을 받은 자는 대한민국 재외공관에 사증발급을 신청할 필요가 없습니다.
2. You may present this document when you are asked for Korean visa verification, and you must present it to a Korean Immigration officer at a port of entry. If you do not bring this document with you, you will need to explain your reason(s) to the immigration officer.
이 확인서는 대한민국 사증발급 여부를 확인받기 위하여 제시할 수 있으며, 대한민국 입국 시 입국심사관에게 제시하여야 합니다. 확인서를 소지 하지 않고 입국하는 경우 그 사유를 입국심사관에게 설명하시기 바랍니다.
3. If you receive an e-Visa, you must enter the Republic of Korea before its expiry date. Please note, however, even if you have the e-Visa, you may be denied entry to the ROK during immigration clearance at the port of entry.
전자사증을 받은 자는 이 확인서 상의 입국만료일 이전에 출입국관리공무원의 입국심사를 받은 후 대한민국에 입국할 수 있습 니다. 다만, 전자사증을 발급받았더라도 입국심사 과정에서 대한민국 입국이 불허될 수 있음을 알려 드립니다.

passages.title: Visa guide: F-5-11 Special talent
passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who has recognized by the Minister of Justice for his/her excellence in a specific field including science, management, education, cultural arts, and athletics

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you have talents in specialized areas such as :

[Science]
- A person recommended by the Minister of Science, ICT, and Future Planning on the basis of the awards history, research publication or citation on SCI (Science Technology Research Citation Index), or Research Results

[Business Management]
- A full-time director at a company with capitals worth more than 8 billion KRW and more than 300 full-time employees, and who is recommended by the head of the Korea Chamber of Commerce · Industry, Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency, or the Korean Federation of Industries.
- A multinational manager or an executive who has worked for 1 year or more at a company listed on the 500 companies in the past 3 years selected by UNCTAD, FORTUNE, FORBES, BUSINESS WEEK(US), or ECONOMIST(UK) and is working at a Korean branch as an executive

[Education]
- A person who is recommended by the Minister of Education on the basis of research publications and citations on SSCI (Social Science Research Citation Index) or A · HCI (Arts and Humanity Research Citation Index), and research achievements.
- A person who is recommended by the Minister of Education, Science and Technology as the status of a full-time lecturer or higher at a community college or above

[Culture＆Arts]
- An internationally famous artist, director, or singer recommended by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism

[Sports]
- An athlete and a coach who won a bronze medal or above at an international athletic competition equivalent to the Olympic, the World Championship, the Asian Game and others. Soccer players and the coaches finished in the Top 16 at the World Cup Game while being recommended by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism of ROK

### Required documents
1. Common documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② Personal Statements
③ Documents proving your annual incomes
④ Documents proving that you have published your research paper in a prominent journal, such as SCI (Science Citation Index), or documents proving your research achievement(s).
⑤ A letter of guarantee
⑥ Degree and other materials(Awards History in relevant field, Certificates of your career experiences)

2. Additional documents for each case
① Science Field: A recommendation letter from the Minister of Science, ICT and Future Planning for Science / a recommendation letter from the Minister of Education for Education
② Education Field: A recommendation letter from the Minister of Education
③ If you are in Business Management, you need to submit a recommendation letter from the head of the Korea Chamber of Commerce＆Industry, the Korea Trade Investment Promotion Agency, or the Federation of Korean Industry
※ If you worked as a multinational manager or an executive at a company listed on the Top 500 companies of the world, you need to submit A proof of employment or a certificate of your career experience that can prove your work experiences.
④ Culture and Sports Area: A recommendation letter from the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism for those in culture and sports industry

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

passages.title: Visa guide: D-8-4 Technology and Business Startup
passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

who has aquirede degree from a Korean university (Bachelor’s degree from an overseas university) or higher

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person acquired a bachelor's degree or higher who is a Corporate founder with intellectual property rights or any equivalent technical skills

### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A certified copy of Corporate Register(unabridged) and a copy of Business Registration Certificate
③ Documents demonstrating that you have either intellectual property right or equivalent skills
④ Any documents proving points earned through the Points-Based System
- A copy of Patent Registration Certificate, Utility Model Right Registration Certificate, Design Registration Certificate, Trade Mark Registration Certificate for intellectual property rights holders
- Patent Candidates must submit application certificate issued by the head of Korea Intellectual Property Office
- A certificate for completion or graduation of the OASIS program issued by the head of Global Investment Center designated by the Minister of Justice, award winner confirmation letter, official statement of selection, and etc.
- Other documents that can prove points earned through the Points-Based System

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person who is a corporate founder with a bachelor's degree or higher and who has intellectual property rights or other equivalent technical skills.

### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② A certified copy of unabridged Corporate Register and a copy of Business Registration Certificate
③ Documents demonstrating an applicant having intellectual property rights or equivalent skills
④ Any documents proving scores earned at Points-Based System
- A copy of Patent Registration Certificate, Utility Model Right Registration Certificate, Design Registration Certificate, Trade Mark Registration Certificate for intellectual property rights holders
- A patent candidate must submit application certificate issued by the head of Korea Intellectual Property Office
- A certificate for completion or graduation of the OASIS program issued by the head of the Global Investment Center designated by the Minister of Justice of ROK, an award winner confirmation letter, an official statement of selection and others.
- Other documents that can prove scores earned at Points-Based System

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.

You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr

passages.title: Visa guide: D-10-1 Job Seeker
passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to engage in a training or find a job in a field qualified for a visa of Professor(E-1), Foreign Language Instructor(E-2), Research(E-3), Technical Instructor/Technician(E-4), Professional(E-5), Artist/Athlete(E-6), and Foreign National of Special Ability(E-7)
- The activities not only include a job seeking or on-the-job training (including short-term paid internship) at an organization or company in ROK
* The activities related to Artist/Athlete(E-6) status only includes pure art or sports, and excludes adult entertainment businesses.

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

① A previous employee of a listed company on the Fortune's Global 500 companies for more than 1 year in recent 3 years
② A graduate of a university listed on the Times' Higher World University Rankings in recent 3 years
③ A graduate of a Korean community college or higher in recent 3 years
④ A person having a bachelor’s degree or above, completed a research program at a Korean research institution in recent 3 years.
⑤ Others who are specially acknowledged by the head of diplomatic mission

### Required documents
1. Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
2. Additional documents for each case
Case ① : Certificate of employment history (Proof of Employment), plan for seeking employment
Case ② : Proof of Education*, plan for seeking employment
* Degree (or a document confirming that you will receive a degree in the future), Certificate of Education, Certificate of your degree (Please choose one)
Case ③ : Proof of education and Transcript, plan for seeking employment
* If a proof of education in Korea can be verified via our system (International student Information System), you are exempt from submitting these documents.
Case ④ : Education Certificate, Completion Certificate*, plan for seeking employment
* A certificate indicating research topic, research period, completion results, which is issued by the head of research institution
Case ⑤ : Documents proving that you are a talent*, plan for seeking employment
* Proof of Education, career certificate, recommendation from the respective group or any other proving documents (if you have been awarded or covered by the media for winning a respected international or domestic competition)

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 6 months.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

question: According to the e-visa issuance confirmation, by when must an e-visa holder enter Korea, and does the e-visa guarantee entry?
reference: They must enter Korea before the e-visa's expiry date. It does not guarantee entry, because the holder may still be denied entry during immigration clearance at the port of entry.
answer: An e-visa holder must enter the Republic of Korea before its expiry date [1, 2, 3]. Even with an e-visa, entry may be denied during immigration clearance at the port of entry [1, 2, 3].

passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

Person who plans to visit Korea for tour or transit without a visa

#### Visa Free Entry Guide
Visa is a fundamental requirement to enter the Republic of Korea, and in principle, foreigners must have valid visas when they travel. However, those who fall under any of the following categories below are allowed to enter Korea without visas. (Article 7(2) of the Immigration Act)
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
Even if the foreigner has the valid visa or is subject to visa-free entry, he/she may be denied entry to the Republic of Korea if he's found inadmissible by an immigration officer at the port of entry.

## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)
### Tourists in transit to Third Countries (* Temporarily Suspended due to COVID-19)

#### 1. Eligible Applicants
-
Nationals of countries, except for the 24 xecluded countries (Syria, Sudan, Iran, Macedonia, Cuba, Republic Of Kosovo, Palestine, Afghanistan, Iraq, Nigeria, Ghana, Yemen, Gambia, Senegal, Bangladesh, Kyrgyzstan, Pakistan, Somalia, Uzbekistan, Nepal, Cameron, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, Egypt) that are not granted visa free entry into Korea.
-
(a) Persons who hold a visa to the United States(including Guam and Saipan), Canada, Australia, or New Zealand, who transit through Korea to enter the abovementioned countries; or (b) persons who stayed in and departed from one of the abovementioned countries and transit through Korea bound for the country of origin or a third country.
-
(a) Persons who hold a visa (or permanent residency) to at least one of the 30 European countires (Greece, Netherlands, Norway, Denmark, Germany, Latvia, Rumania, Luxemburg, Lithuania, Liechtenstein, Malta, Belgium, Sweden, Switzerland, Spain, Slovakia, Slovenia, Iceland, Ireland, Estonia, United Kingdom, Austria, Italy, Czech, Cyprus, Portugal, Poland, France, Finland, Hungary), who transit through Korea bound for one of the 30 European countries; or (b) persons who departed from one of the 30 European countries, transit through Korea bound for the country of origin or a third country.

#### 2. Requirements
-
Persons who hold a visa (re-entry permit, permanent residency, etc.) to enter the United States, Canada, Australia, or New Zealand (hereinafter referred to as “the four advanced countries”) and
-
1) who go to one of the four advanced countries in transit through Korea; or
-
2) who stay in one of the four advanced countries and take a direct flight from the country to Korea to go to a country of nationality or a third country.
-
Please be noted that:
-
- If you are a U.S. visa holder who transit through Korea and Saipan to reach the U.S. as the final destination, you are permitted to enter Korea without a visa. (However, if you depart from the U.S. and enter Korea via Saipan, you are not granted no-visa entry to Korea.)
-
- If you are a Chinese group tourist holding a group-tourist visa to Japan and meet certain requirements (e.g. using a travel agency that only attracts Chinese group tourists), you are permitted to enter Korea without a visa.
-
- If you hold an e-visa to Australia and a visa label is attached to your passport, you are permitted to enter Korea without a visa. However, if the label is not on your passport, you are granted no-visa entry only when you depart from Australia and transit through Korea.

#### 3. Condition of Permission
-
You have a confirmed onward flight ticket for departure within 30 days after entering Korea, in addition to having no record of criminal offence such as overstay in the countries mentioned above
-
You had not been denied entry into Korea, or had not been fined more than 5 million KRW or not have been forcibly evicted or received a deportation order for violation of law in the past 3 years preceding the date of entry
-
You stayed no more than 3 days in the country of transit or stopover. (But, Not applicable when the person is returning to the immediate previous point of departure(country of transit or stopover)
-
For hloders of U.S., Canada, Australia, or New Zealand e-visas, a visa sticker must be attached to the passport; if unattached, visa free entry will be applicable when departing from the 4 countries mentioned above bound for the country of origin or a third country.

### Tourists in transit to Third Countries (* Temporarily Suspended due to COVID-19)

#### 1. Eligible Applicants
-
Nationals of countries, except for the 24 xecluded countries (Syria, Sudan, Iran, Macedonia, Cuba, Republic Of Kosovo, Palestine, Afghanistan, Iraq, Nigeria, Ghana, Yemen, Gambia, Senegal, Bangladesh, Kyrgyzstan, Pakistan, Somalia, Uzbekistan, Nepal, Cameron, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, Egypt) that are not granted visa free entry into Korea.
-
(a) Persons who hold a visa to the United States(including Guam and Saipan), Canada, Australia, or New Zealand, who transit through Korea to enter the abovementioned countries; or (b) persons who stayed in and departed from one of the abovementioned countries and transit through Korea bound for the country of origin or a third country.
-
(a) Persons who hold a visa (or permanent residency) to at least one of the 30 European countires (Greece, Netherlands, Norway, Denmark, Germany, Latvia, Rumania, Luxemburg, Lithuania, Liechtenstein, Malta, Belgium, Sweden, Switzerland, Spain, Slovakia, Slovenia, Iceland, Ireland, Estonia, United Kingdom, Austria, Italy, Czech, Cyprus, Portugal, Poland, France, Finland, Hungary), who transit through Korea bound for one of the 30 European countries; or (b) persons who departed from one of the 30 European countries, transit through Korea bound for the country of origin or a third country.

#### 2. Requirements
-
Persons who hold a visa (re-entry permit, permanent residency, etc.) to enter the United States, Canada, Australia, or New Zealand (hereinafter referred to as “the four advanced countries”) and
-
1) who go to one of the four advanced countries in transit through Korea; or
-
2) who stay in one of the four advanced countries and take a direct flight from the country to Korea to go to a country of nationality or a third country.
-
Please be noted that:
-
- If you are a U.S. visa holder who transit through Korea and Saipan to reach the U.S. as the final destination, you are permitted to enter Korea without a visa. (However, if you depart from the U.S. and enter Korea via Saipan, you are not granted no-visa entry to Korea.)
-
- If you are a Chinese group tourist holding a group-tourist visa to Japan and meet certain requirements (e.g. using a travel agency that only attracts Chinese group tourists), you are permitted to enter Korea without a visa.
-
- If you hold an e-visa to Australia and a visa label is attached to your passport, you are permitted to enter Korea without a visa. However, if the label is not on your passport, you are granted no-visa entry only when you depart from Australia and transit through Korea.

#### 3. Condition of Permission
-
You have a confirmed onward flight ticket for departure within 30 days after entering Korea, in addition to having no record of criminal offence such as overstay in the countries mentioned above
-
You had not been denied entry into Korea, or had not been fined more than 5 million KRW or not have been forcibly evicted or received a deportation order for violation of law in the past 3 years preceding the date of entry
-
You stayed no more than 3 days in the country of transit or stopover. (But, Not applicable when the person is returning to the immediate previous point of departure(country of transit or stopover)
-
For hloders of U.S., Canada, Australia, or New Zealand e-visas, a visa sticker must be attached to the passport; if unattached, visa free entry will be applicable when departing from the 4 countries mentioned above bound for the country of origin or a third country.

question: On the Application for Certificate of Visa Eligibility form as revised in December 2023, what extra information must you give if you tick 'Work' as the purpose of visit?
reference: The 2-digit Korean standard occupation code and industry code. The codes can be found on the Korea Visa Portal website.
answer: If 'Work' is selected, you must provide the 2-digit occupation and industry code (한국표준직업분류코드 Occupation Code and 한국표준산업분류코드 Industry Code) [1].

고의로 신청서에 거짓된 사실을 기재하는 경우 신청이 불허되며, 관계 법령에 따라 불이익을 받을 수 있으며, 거짓된 사실을 기재 하여 사증을 발급받아 입국하거나 체류허가를 받은 외국인은 허가를 받았더라도 동법 제46조에 따라 강제퇴거될 수 있습니다.
Ahead of submitting this form, make sure you answered all of the questions to the best of your knowledge. If a necessary answer has been omitted, the evaluation process for the application may be delayed or disapproved. If you have documents proving the information written in this form, please submit them together at the time of application. If false information is knowingly or willingly submitted on this form, your application can be refused, and you can be penalized according to the relevant Act.
Even if you are issued a Visa and subsequently admitted to the Republic of Korea, proving false or misleading information on this form could be grounds for deportation according to the Article 46 of the immigration Act.
