question: On the visa application form for people who already have a visa issuance confirmation, what passport change does the applicant have to declare?
reference: Whether the passport has been changed within the recent 3 months.
answer: The applicant must declare if there has been a change of passport within the recent 3 months [1].

passages.file_name: [별지 제17호서식] 사증발급신청서 VISA APPLICATION FORM(한글, 영문).pdf
passages.snippet:
1. 위 기재사항과 관련하여 자세한 내용은 별지로 작성하거나 관련 서류를 추가로 제출할 수 있습니다.
If extra space is needed to complete any item, record on a separate sheet of paper or submit relevant documents which could support the application.
2. 대한민국 사증을 승인받은 후 분실 또는 훼손 등의 사유로 여권을 새로 발급받은 경우에는, 정확한 개인정보를 반영할 수 있도록 변경된 여권정보를 사증처리기관에 통보해야 합니다.
If you received Korean visa approval, and have new passport issued thereafter in lieu of lost/damaged passpor t, you must notify the concerned visa office of changes in your passport information.
3. 사증을 발급받았더라도 대한민국 입국 시 입국거부 사유가 발견될 경우에는 대한민국으로의 입국이 허가되지 않을 수 있습니다.
Possession of a visa does not entitle the bearer to enter the Republic of Korea upon arrival at the port of entry if he/she is found inadmissible.
4. 「출입국관리법 시행규칙」 제9조제1항에 따라 C 계열 사증소지자는 입국 후에 체류자격을 변경할 수 없습니다. Please note that category C visa holders are not able to change their status of stay after their entry into the Repu
blic of Korea in accordance with Article 9(1) of the Enforcement Regulations of the Immigration Act.

passages.title: Visa guide: D-10-1 Job Seeker
passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to engage in a training or find a job in a field qualified for a visa of Professor(E-1), Foreign Language Instructor(E-2), Research(E-3), Technical Instructor/Technician(E-4), Professional(E-5), Artist/Athlete(E-6), and Foreign National of Special Ability(E-7)
- The activities not only include a job seeking or on-the-job training (including short-term paid internship) at an organization or company in ROK
* The activities related to Artist/Athlete(E-6) status only includes pure art or sports, and excludes adult entertainment businesses.

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

① A previous employee of a listed company on the Fortune's Global 500 companies for more than 1 year in recent 3 years
② A graduate of a university listed on the Times' Higher World University Rankings in recent 3 years
③ A graduate of a Korean community college or higher in recent 3 years
④ A person having a bachelor’s degree or above, completed a research program at a Korean research institution in recent 3 years.
⑤ Others who are specially acknowledged by the head of diplomatic mission

### Required documents
1. Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
2. Additional documents for each case
Case ① : Certificate of employment history (Proof of Employment), plan for seeking employment
Case ② : Proof of Education*, plan for seeking employment
* Degree (or a document confirming that you will receive a degree in the future), Certificate of Education, Certificate of your degree (Please choose one)
Case ③ : Proof of education and Transcript, plan for seeking employment
* If a proof of education in Korea can be verified via our system (International student Information System), you are exempt from submitting these documents.
Case ④ : Education Certificate, Completion Certificate*, plan for seeking employment
* A certificate indicating research topic, research period, completion results, which is issued by the head of research institution
Case ⑤ : Documents proving that you are a talent*, plan for seeking employment
* Proof of Education, career certificate, recommendation from the respective group or any other proving documents (if you have been awarded or covered by the media for winning a respected international or domestic competition)

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 6 months.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who meets the qualifications determined by the Minister of Justice, and plans to teach conversational language at a foreign language institute, affiliated- language research institute or educational institute of higher than elementary school, or language training institute affiliated with an enterprise or broadcasting company, or other equivalent organization.

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

1. An instructor at an English Academy
- A person who teaches a foreign language in accordance with Article 3(3) of the presidential decree of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of Private Teaching Institutes and Extracurricular Lessons
2. An instructor who is recruited/selected by an academic institution such as elementary school (or higher) or an affiliated language center
3. A foreign language instructor at corporate language centers for employee on-the-job-training
4. A foreign language instructor at a continuing education institute in accordance with the Lifelong Education Act
* School affiliated continuing education facilities, school·company's internal college·cyber university, business places· civil society groups· media affiliated continuing education facilities, continuing education related to knowledge·human resource development
5. A foreign language instructor teaching at a continuing education facility that is established and run by the state or other local governments in accordance with other laws (including regulations)
6. A foreign language instructor teaching at a vocational skills development facility or vocational training corporation established in accordance with the Workers Vocational Skills Development Act
7. A foreign language instructor teaching at a corporation or a public institute* which has set up a language center that has all the necessary equipment and facilities to study a foreign language for its employees

### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② A proof of an applicant's education authenticated by a public authority*.
Please, choose one from below to submit;
A copy of a degree, a copy of diploma, a graduation certificate indicating an acquisition of a degree
*The document needs to be authenticated by the Hague Apostille Convention(for a signatory of the convention), by consular officers of a Korean diplomatic mission abroad (for not a signatory of the convention), or by an official public institute in Korea (i.e. Korean Council for University Education), or by a government agency of applicants(Japanese only)
- If you have a degree from a university in ROK, an un-authenticated copy of a degree will also be accepted.
- If you have a history of submitting a document authenticated by the institutes listed above, you are exempt from the requirement.
③ A criminal record issued and authenticated by a public authority* in an applicant's country
* The document needs to be authenticated under the Hague Apostille Convention(for a signatory of the convention), by consular officers of a Korean diplomatic mission abroad (for not a signatory of the convention), or by consular officers of a foreign embassy in Korea (for a foreign resident in Korea)
- The criminal records that includes all criminal records across the country, must be issued within 6 months from the application date.
- If you have a history of submitting a criminal record authenticated by a public authority, staying and leaving ROK, and re-apply within 3 months from the last departure from ROK, you are exempt from submitting the document. However, if it has been more than 3 months since the last departure, you need to re-submit it when applying for an alien registration.
④ A Self-Assessment Report on Heath
⑤ An employment contract, and a document of the establishment of an academic institute or an organization
⑥ Other necessary documents for evaluation
- an outline of teachers management, a document suggesting the total number of students and faculties

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 2 years.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 2 years.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr

- 1 -
❍ The Ministry of Justice of the Republic of Korea extends the current visa fee waiver policy for group tourists through to the end of next year by reflecting the opinions of the tourism industry and relevant authorities.
Note: The Ministry has implemented visa fee wavier policy (effective from July 6, 2015 to Dec. 31, 2015) for group tourists from five countries (China, Vietnam, Indonesia, Philippines and Cambodia) following the MERS outbreak.

passages.snippet:

- Exemption of Visa Application Fees for Group Tourists
- Extension of Visa Expiration Date
- Expansion of No-visa Entry
❍ The Ministry of Justice of the Republic of Korea has decided to implement proactive measures such as exemption of visa application fees in order to provide foreign tourists with easier and convenient access to Korea and thereby support the concerned tourism industry following the recent Middle East Respiratory Syndrome (MERS) outbreak.
❍ The measures include:
1. First, exemption of visa application fees for group tourists from China and other countries for three months (from July 6 to September 30)
- Visa application fees for Chinese group tourists (currently about 15 US dollars per person) are exempt for three months to support attracting foreign tourists.
- The same exemption measure applies to four Southeast Asian countries (Vietnam, Philippines, Indonesia and Cambodia) to which group tourist visas
- 2 - are issued.
2. Second, validity extension of single-entry visas that were issued before and after the MERS development (from March 1 to June 30, 2015) from the current three months to six months
- Persons subject to the extension are allowed to enter the Republic of Korea even after the visa expiration date, which would prevent them from going through inconvenient procedures such as visiting a diplomatic mission to have their visa extended.
Note: About 1.09 million foreigners were granted a single-entry visa from March to June 2015. The Ministry will promote relevant information through diplomatic missions in China and other countries so that foreigners can benefit from it.
3. Third, no-visa entry for Chinese group tourists holding a Japanese group tourist visa
- About 1.1 million chinese group tourists were granted a Japanese group tourist visa in 2014. The no-visa entry is expected to provide Chinese tourists travelling Japan with easier and convenient access to Korea so that they can enjoy tourism activities while staying in the country for a maximum of 15 days.
- At the same time, the Ministry will prepare restrictive measures to eliminate concerns over illegal stays of tourists that may be caused by the implementation of the measure in order to minimize possible side effects.
❍ The above measures were designed to dispel public concerns over the tourism industry following the MERS outbreak and to support foreigners with easier and convenient access to Korea. The Ministry of Justice expects the measures to contribute to revitalizing the tourism industry and the Korean economy.

passages.title: Visa guide: C-3-9 Ordinary Tourist
passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to visit Korea on the purpose of travel for holidays or leisure

## Embassy visa application

### Embassy visa application — Case 1

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are a person who plans to visit Korea on the purpose of travel for holidays or leisure

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② Documents demonstrating the financial capacity during the stay in ROK or a document for identification

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months or a double-entry visa valid for 6 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 90 days for a single-entry visa , and 30 days for a double-entry visa.

### Embassy visa application — Case 2

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

a preferential visit card holder and the family (spouse, minor child, parents, and parents-in-law).

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A copy of preferential visit card
③ Document proving applicant's qualification for a preferential visit card (bank book or certificate of bank account balance )
※ not applicable for holders of "preferential card without financial function"
④ A document proving family relations (Marriage Certificate, Certificate of Family Relation Records, Birth Certificate and others)

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 5 years. Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.

### Embassy visa application — Case 3

#### Eligibility
□ Multiple Entry Visa (Valid for 5 years)

1) A faculty member* at a university (including junior college), or a teacher of elementary, middle, or high school
* A faculty member positioned higher than an assistant professor is eligible for multiple entry visa with validity of 10 years
2) Famous artists, entertainers, and athletes acknowledged by the head of a Korean diplomatic mission abroad
3) A person who has entered the ROK more than 3 times as a tour guide of travel agencies which serve Chinese group tourists
4) A person who has visited the ROK previously
＆lt;Note＆gt;
- No-visa Entries (including landing permit) are NOT counted towards the total visits made to the ROK
- Visits on a Medical Tourism visa are acknowledged only when the total medical fees paid for clinics and/or hospitals in the ROK exceed 2 million KRW during the recent 1 year
- Entries on C-3-2 (Group Tourist) are acknowledged only when the entries had been made before January 28, 2016

5) A manager (or of higher position) of a private enterprise which has an annual trade volume of US $30,000 (or above) with the Republic of Korea, or a full-time employee who has worked for such enterprise for 2 years or more.

6) A person who has proved his/her assets including real estate, financial assets, business ownership, etc. worth more than 2 million yuan

7) A public/civil servant of China or a official passport holder
8) An executive or an employee of a corporate which has invested more than $1,000,000 (1 billion KRW) in the Republic of Korea
9) An executive or an employee of an airline or a shipping company providing services to the ROK (Irrespective of regular, irregular, or chartered services)
10) A VIP customer of an internationally accepted credit card company with the granted level above Gold-Card
11) A person whose monthly income is more than 5000 yuan (or an annual income of 60,000 yuan)
12) A person aged less than 17 or more than 55

13) Currently enrolled or graduated* students from a university
* Submission of Degree Certificate (China Credentials Verification) from the China
Higher Education Student Information and Career Center (www.chsi.com.cn) REQUIRED

14) A section chief (or higher level) or an employee (six months of work or longer) currently working at one of the 500 companies selected by China Enterprise Confederation (CEC)
* Please check http://www.cec-ceda.org.cn for your reference

15) A person who has purchased a membership card (worth 30 million KRW or above) of a condominium located in the Republic of Korea*
* Verification by a certificate of acquisition tax payment

16) The spouse, underaged children, parents, or parents-in-law of a valid multiple-entry C-3 (Short-Term General) visa holder*
* Multiple entry visas falling under the following cases are excluded
- C-3-8 multiple entry visa holders
- A person aged less than 17 or more than 55
- Currently enrolled or graduated* students from a university

17) Residents* of Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, and Shenzhen
* REQUIRED TO submit the original copy of the New Resident Identity Card (with forgery prevention features). If without the New Resident Identity Card (only), may submit a passport, old resident identity card, household register, etc.

18) A person who has previously visited one of the OECD member countries (22 in total) holding a Visitor visa (excluding Group visa)

□ Multiple Entry Visa (Valid for 10 years)

1) Professionals such as doctor, lawyer, professor*, CEO of a public/private enterprise, etc.
* Assistant professor or higher at a university
** Private enterprises capitalized at 5 billion or above

2) A holder of domestic bachelor’s degree (or higher) from a university (including graduates) or a holder of foreign master’s degree

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② Two different documents proving your identity and financial ability to support yourself during the stay in ROK

[ Examples of Documents Proving Your Identity and Financial Ability ]
Proof of employment, credit card statement within the past 6 months, Certificate of Social Insurance Registration, Tax Clearance Certificate, Degree Certificate, Permanent Residence Certificate, Invitation Letter from a specific institution, a document proving that you have collected your pension, proof of employment verifying you have worked as an executive member or a full-time employee at a respective company, records of international trade with ROK

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
A multiple-entry visa valid for 3 years, or 5 years will be issued to an eligible applicant.
Period of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.

question: How many D-3-13 plant trainees can one host company in Korea accept?
reference: Not in the corpus. The D-3-13 page asks for proof of the host company's number of full-time employees to determine the permitted number of trainees, but does not state the number.
answer: The passages do not state the specific number of trainees a host company can accept, only that documents proving the number of full-time employees of the host company must be submitted to determine the permitted number of accepting trainees [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: D-3-13 Industrial Trainee (Plant)
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to engage in training at an entity which exports industrial facilities(plants) in accordance with the Foreign Trade Act

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

An production employee of a foreign company that has imported industrial facilities or plants worth of US$500,000 or more, and who is deemed to require receiving job training to manage the facilities or plants

[ Trainee Requirements ]
1. A healthy person aged between 18 and 40 2. More than 3 months of working experience at the Korean subsidiary
2. More than 3 months working experience at a local subsidiary
3. Acquiring second-level or higher, or score of 50 out of 200 on TOPIK (excluding those who have a bachelor’s degree or higher in Korea, or who plans to receive training at the corporation that has signed a pledge to implement Korean language education 5 hours or more per month, and hire a full-time translator per 100 trainees)

### Required documents
1. Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
2. Documents proving an invitee has met requirements for being an industrial trainee
① A copy of Business Registration Certificate of the branch office located in an applicant's country (or a charter)
② Invitee’s Employment Certificate issued by the head of a branch office and a copy of passport.
③ Documents proving sufficiency in Korean
※ if there is a Korean diplomatic mission in an applicant's country, ① and ② need to be authenticated by consular officers
3. A training course plan that can confirm the details of training schedule. (Refer to Archive)
4. A letter of guarantee from inviter
※ If there are two principle debtors or more, you can submit one reference letter with an enclosed “Invitee List” on the confirmation of visa issuance.
5. Documents proving that the host company is a permitted corporation as a Plant export business
- An approval for a plant export (including an approval for amendment)
6. Documents proving the number of full time employees of the host company in order to determine the permitted number of accepting trainees
- You need to submit a statement of insurance qualification printed out from the website of the Ministry of Employment and Labor (Employment Insurance website)
7. Documents demonstrating the on-the-job training facilities such as photos of dormitory for more details of training or housing facilities.

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 6 months.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr

question: An administrative staff member of a foreign embassy in Korea applies for an A-2 visa at a Korean embassy. What kind of visa can they get and how long can they stay?
reference: They can apply for a single-entry or a multiple-entry visa and may stay in Korea until the end of their assignment.
answer: You can apply for a single-entry or multiple-entry visa [1]. You will be allowed to stay in Korea until the end of your assignment [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: A-2 Foreign Government Official
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

- A person working for an international organization or a foreign governments approved by the Republic of Korea
- Immediate family members of the above

## Embassy visa application

### Embassy visa application — Case 1

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

1. A person performs official tasks for a foreign government or an international organization
- Administrative, technical or service staff of a foreign diplomatic mission in Korea
- Administrative, technical or service staff of a foreign consular office in Korea
- Employees of an international organization whose headquarters is located in Korea
- Employees of an international organization or foreign government, working at their Korean mission(s) for their assignments.
- People dispatched by a foreign government and international organization for official mission(s) with the Korea Government
- People attending a conference and other events hosted by an international Organization
2. Immediate family members of the above applicants
- Immediate family members who live with the above applicants

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport(Laissez-passer, international organization passer, diplomatic passport), a photo in a standard format
② A document demonstrating your current employment status and overseas assignment, or an official letter of cooperation written by the Minister of Foreign Affairs of an applicant's country
③ A certificate of family relation and any documents proving family relationship for an accompanied family member

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry or multiple-entry visa, and you will be allowed to stay in Korea until the end of your assignment.

### Embassy visa application — Case 2

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

1. Officials and conference attendees of an international organization located in Korea, but who are not qualified for A-1 diplomatic visas
2. Immediate family members of the above applicants.

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport(Laissez-passer, international organization passer, diplomatic passport), a photo in a standard format
② A document demonstrating your current employment status and overseas assignment, or an official letter of cooperation written by the Minister of Foreign Affairs of an applicant's country
③ A certificate of family relation and any documents proving family relationship for an accompanied family member

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
If you want to work at the embassy/consulate of your country in Korea, you can apply for a multiple-entry visa. In this case, you will be allowed to stay in Korea until the end of your assignment. However, if you are just visiting Korea on a short-term assignment, you can apply for a single-entry visa. Please contact the Korean Embassy or Consulate General(s) in your country for more information.

### Embassy visa application — Case 3

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

1. Officials or conference attendees of an Inter-governmental organization in which the Republic of Korea is involved, but who are not qualified for A-1 diplomatic visas
2. Immediate family members of the above applicants.

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport(Laissez-passer, international organization passer, diplomatic passport), a photo in a standard format
② A document demonstrating your current employment status and overseas assignment, or an official letter of cooperation written by the Minister of Foreign Affairs of an applicant's country
③ A certificate of family relation and any documents proving family relationship for an accompanied family member

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
If you want to work at the embassy/consulate of your country in Korea, you can apply for a multiple-entry visa. In this case, you will be allowed to stay in Korea until the end of your assignment. However, if you are just visiting Korea on a short-term assignment, you can apply for a single-entry visa. Please contact the Korean Embassy or Consulate General(s) in your country for more information.

question: A university lecturer is invited to give lectures in Korea for less than 90 days. Which visa applies if they receive no compensation other than flight and accommodation, and if they are paid, what contract or invitation document must the C-4 application include?
reference: With no compensation other than flight and accommodation, they are eligible for a Short-term General (C-3-1) visa. If paid (C-4), they submit an employment contract on providing lectures or public speeches, or an invitation card that indicates the lecture fees.
answer: If the lecturer is not compensated other than flight and accommodation, they are eligible for a Short-term General (C-3-1) visa [1]. If they are paid, the C-4 application must include an employment contract (on providing lectures·public speeches) or an invitation card that indicates lecture fees and others (a document of request for visa issuance cooperation) [1].

A person who plans to visit for a short-term employment such as temporary show, advertising·modeling, lecturing·speeching, research, technology consulting, etc.

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person who is applicable for a Professor(E-1) visa or a Foreign National of Special Ability (E-7) visa, and plans to give a lecture, give public speeches, or research for less than 90 days on the basis of a contract for profits as an expert in a particular area or a university instructor
※ If the lecturer or speaker is not compensated other than flight and accommodation, he/she is eligible for a Short-term General (C-3-1) visa.

You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 3 months under the Visa Exemption Agreement between two countries.

question: What are the trainee requirements for a D-3-12 industrial trainee (technology)?
reference: The trainee must be a healthy person aged 18 to 40, have more than 3 months of working experience at a local subsidiary, and have TOPIK level 2 or higher or a score of 50 out of 200. The TOPIK requirement does not apply to those with a bachelor's degree or higher from Korea, or to training at a corporation that pledges at least 5 hours a month of Korean language education and one full-time translator per 100 trainees.
answer: The trainee requirements are: 1. A healthy person aged between 18 and 40 [1]. 2. More than 3 months of working experience at a local subsidiary [1]. 3. Acquiring second-level or higher, or score of 50 out of 200 on TOPIK (excluding those who have a bachelor’s degree or higher in Korea, or who plans to receive training at the corporation that has signed a pledge to implement Korean language education 5 hours or more per month, and hire a full-time translator per 100 trainees) [1].

Acquiring second-level or higher, or score of 50 out of 200 on TOPIK (excluding those who have a bachelor’s degree or higher in Korea, or who plans to receive training at the corporation that has signed a pledge to implement Korean language education 5 hours or more per month, and hire a full-time translator per 100 trainees)

### Required documents
1. Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
2. Documents proving an invitee has met requirements for being an industrial trainee
① A copy of Business Registration Certificate of the branch office located in an applicant's country (or a charter)
② Invitee’s Employment Certificate issued by the head of a branch office and a copy of passport.
③ Documents proving sufficiency in Korean
※ If there is a Korean diplomatic mission in an applicant's country, ① and ② need to be authenticated by consular officers
3. A training course plan confirming the details of training schedule. (refer to Archive)
4. A letter of guarantee from inviter
5. Documents proving the host company is a permitted corporation as a technology export business
- A copy of technology export agreement in Korean
- A written approval letter is required, if an approval from the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy of ROK is required in accordance with the 「International Trade Act」or the「Act on Industrial Technology Drain Protection and Prevention」.
6. Documents proving the number of Korean full-time employees of the host company in order to determine the permitted number of trainees
- You need to submit a statement of insurance qualification printed out from the website of the Ministry of Employment and Labor (Employment Insurance website)
7. Documents demonstrating the on-the-job training facilities such as photos of dormitory for more details of training or housing facilities.

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 6 months.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr

## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person with at least high school diploma or the equivalent, who plans to study Korean language at a language institution affiliated with a foreign education institution in the ROK or at a higher education institution established in accordance with the Higher Education Act

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person with at least high school diploma or the equivalent, who plans to study Korean language at an institution established in accordance with the Higher Education Act, or the Special Act on Establishment and Management of Foreign Educational Institutions in Free Economic Zones and Jeju Free International City

### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee

② A copy of Business Registration Certificate (or Registration Number Certificate) of a respective education institute

③ Standard Acceptance Letter* (issued by the dean/president of the university)

* For scholarship students invited by the National Institute for International Education, an invitation letter issued by the director can be a replacement

④ Certificate of enrollment or documents proving the highest level of education. Original documents notarized in the following ways should be submitted.

(Notarization of diploma) Nationals of 21 countrires designated by Minister of Justice or those who have acquired a degree/credential from a high school or university located in countries subject to intensive management should submit one of the following (original) documents of ⓐ, ⓑ and ⓒ in accordance with the relevant provisions (For China only ⓒ allowed )

ⓐ Documents proving a degree (credential) certified with Apostille

ⓑ Documents proving a degree or others confirmed by a Korean consul stationed in the country where the school is located or by a consul of the country concerned stationed in the ROK

ⓒ As for China: Verification/Credentials Report of a degree or others issued by the China Higher Education Student Information and Career Center/China Academic Degrees and Graduate Education Development Center operated by the Ministry of Education of China (only applicable to those who acquired a degree/credential in China)

※ Yet, those who acquired a degree (credential) from a Korean uninversity or others are allowed to submit a diploma without official certification ( Copies will be stored after verfication with the original diploma and the records on the Immigration Control Information System)

- As for graduates from a vocational high school for which Verification/Credentials Report of a degree or others is not available,

ⅰ) For a diploma issued by a relevant school, confirmation by Provincial Office of Education (or Municipal Bureau of Education) and a Korean consul stationed in China is necessary, or

ⅱ) For a diploma issued by Provincial Office of Education (or Municipal Bureau of Education), confirmation by a Korean consul stationed in China is necessary to review the highest degree or level of education

⑤ Original copy of document proving your financial statement*

* In principle, documents proving your financial abilities must be reviewed through original copies (ex, bank statement, bankbook, scholarship receipt, deposit/withdrawal statement), and when necessary, a duplicate copy can be attached after an official-in-charge compares the original copy and duplicate copy to confirm authenticity (bank statement is only accepted when it is issued within the past 30 days)

※ When submitting a parents bank statement, family relation certificate must be attached.

⑥ Training Plan (Lecture Schedule, Lecturers Profiles, Training Facility and etc.)

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 6 months.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

question: my son is going to a korean high school on a D-4-3 visa and im his parent and guardian. do we still have to hand in a guardianship statement?
reference: Yes. For a D-4-3 student with a designated guardian, a written statement of guardianship must be submitted even if the guardian is a parent or a family member closer than the second degree.

## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to study at an academic institution equivalent to high school or below

## Embassy visa application

### Embassy visa application — Case 1

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

An international student invited to study in Korea on a full scholarship offered by an organization, who has been accepted to an educational organization and is planning to enroll in the school

Eligible educational organizations are
Elementary school, middle school, high school or Foreigner school in accordance with the 「Elementary and Secondary Education Act」, or Foreign educational institution in accordance with the「Special Act on Establishment and Management of Foreign Educational Institutions in Free Economic Zones and Jeju International City」.

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A copy of Business Registration Certificate (or Registration Number Certificate) of a respective education institute
③ Acceptance Letter (issued by the President of School)
④ Documents demonstrating the highest level of your education (Graduation Certificate or Proof of Enrollment and etc.)
⑤ Documents proving a full scholarship student(official documents issued by organization or groups)
⑥ In case the inviting group such as corporation, financial ability certification in need
- Guardianship warranty
- Verifying document of the inviting group’s financial soundness such as copy of corporate registration

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

An international student having a designated guardian and has been accepted to an educational organization and is planning to enroll in the school

Eligible educational organizations are
Elementary school, middle school, high school or Foreigner school in accordance with the 「Elementary and Secondary Education Act」, or Foreign educational institution in accordance with the「Special Act on Establishment and Management of Foreign Educational Institutions in Free Economic Zones and Jeju International City」.

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee

④ Documents demonstrating the highest level of your education (Graduation Certificate or Proof of Enrollment and etc.)

question: For a D-9-4 individual foreign businessman visa, what investment is enough if the applicant signs up to hire Korean workers?

answer: A person signing up for hiring Korean workers is eligible for this visa in the case of making an investment of 200 million KRW or more [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: D-9-4 Individual Foreign Business Man

## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to run a domestic business or company (with business registration according to the 「Value-Added Tax Act」) after raising a certain amount of foreign capital in accordance with the 「Foreign Exchange Transactions Act」 and 「Regulations of Foreign Exchange Transactions」or an individual businessman of a company with an issued registration certificate of investment after reporting that a company has made a certain amount of foreign investment in accordance with the 「Foreign Investment Promotion Act」

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

1. A person who has completed a business registration under Value Added Tax Laws and plans to manage a company or engage in for-profit activities in Korea, after having invested foreign capitals worth 300 million KRW in accordance with Foreign Exchange Transaction Act and Foreign Exchange Transaction Regulation,
2. A private entrepreneur who has completed the foreigner investment notification and has been issued a certificate of foreign-invested company registration, after having invested 300 million KRW or more in accordance with the Foreign Investment Promotion Act

※ A person signing up for hiring Korean workers is eligible for applying for this visa in the case of making an investment of 200 million KRW or more.

### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A copy of Business Registration Certificate, a copy of business license (not required by all), a copy of Certificate of FDI Company Registration (holders only)
③ Documents (both original and photocopy) of joint venture contract (not required by all)
※ The documents above should include details on the gross capital, equity, profit sharing allocation method.
④ Documents on business fund
- A certificate of wire transfer, certificate of foreign currency purchase, customs declaration,
⑤ Detailed statement of business fund expenditure
- Receipt of purchased goods, office interior's costs, domestic bank statement
⑥ Any documents proving the sales record
- Trade(import and export) permit, value-added tax or final tax return, etc.
※ Limited to those who has engaged in sales activities with general business visitor visa such as (C-3-4), prior to apply for the D-9 visa
⑦ Documents confirming the existence of your company
- Office rental contract, photographic documents of workplace, offices, and signs
⑧ Pledge to hire Korean(if applicable)

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

citations.title: Visa guide: E-1 Professor
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who meets the qualifications stated in the 「Higher Education Act」, and plans to engage in education or research·guidance of the professional field at educational institutions of higher than the college level or any of the equivalents

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application — Case 1

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

The head of a university (i.e. chancellor, or dean), a professor, associate professor, assistant professor, lecturer with concurrent posts, honorary professor, visiting scholar, or an exchange professor who plans to teach or research at a community college or above for at least 91 days.

1. A chancellor or dean refers to the head of a university who is hired by a prescribed procedure and oversees school affairs and faculties, and teaches students
2. A professor, associate professor, or assistant professor refers to an instructor whose qualification is acknowledged by the Human Resources Committee or Teacher’s Personnel Committee of a respective university, or who meets the requirements set forth as Article 16 of the Higher Education Act, and teaches and guides students and conduct academic research.

question: A D-7 visa holder wants to invite their parents on an F-1-15 visa as a foreign talent. What annual income must they have?
reference: At least twice the per capita GNI of the previous year. If they changed to that status after earning a bachelor's degree or higher in Korea, the minimum is lowered to the per capita GNI of the previous year.
answer: The D-7 visa holder must have an annual income of twice per capita GNI of the previous year or more [1]. However, if they changed their status of stay to D-7 after earning a bachelor's degree or higher in Korea, the minimum annual income requirement is lowered to per capita GNI of the previous year or more [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: F-1-15 Parents of Foreign Talents, etc
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A parent of a foreign talent, investor, student and their spouse

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A parent of a person satisfying the following requirements and a parent of the person's spouse
① (foreign talent) a Long-term News Coverage (D-5), Intra-Company Transferee (D-7), Corporate/Foreign Investor (D-8), International Trade (D-9), and from Professor (E-1) to Foreign National of Special Ability (E-7) visa holder whose annual income is twice per capita GNI of the previous year or more
- Including a person who has changed his/her status of stay to F-2, F-5, etc. while maintaining the same activities falling under the above statuses
- However, if you change your status of stay to the above statuses (D-5, D-7, D-8, D-9 or E-1 - E-7) after earning a bachelor's degree or higher in Korea, the minimum annual income requirement is lowered to per capita GNI of the previous year or more.
② (investor) a registered foreigner who has invested 300 million KRW in Korea and stayed in the country for 6 months or more in accordance with the Foreign Investment Promotion Act, the Foreign Exchange Transaction Act and the Immigrant Investor Scheme.
③ (student) a foreign student enrolled in a master's/doctoral program of Korea who has stayed in the country for 6 months or more
- However, if the accompanying family members including invitees are more than three, they should prove that they have at least 50％ of per capita GNI of the previous year in Korea for annual living expenses in addition to tuition.

### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② A copy of inviter's Alien Registration Card, a reference letter, a statement of invitation (suggesting that the invitee would not seek a job), documents proving the place of residence
③ Documents proving family relations
※ A Marriage Certificate, a certificate on family relations or a Birth Certificate
④ Documents proving inviter's income/invested money/living expenses

※ If you hire a representative, you must submit a power of Attorney, the proof of current employment status of your representative, and a photocopy of your representative IDs
※ The head of Immigration Office may request additional documents if it is deemed necessary to examine the purpose of entry, the genuineness of the invitation, and the qualifications of the inviter and the invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months. Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.

question: For an F-1-22 household assistant of a big investor, how long is the period of stay when applying at an embassy, and when applying through Confirmation of Visa Issuance?
reference: Embassy application: a stay of up to 1 year. Confirmation of Visa Issuance (CCVI) application: a stay of up to 90 days.

citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to work for a heavy investor as a household assistant under contract with him/her

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A household assistant of a foreign investor (CEO or executives) who has invested $500,000 or more and acquired a status of stay of a Corporate/Foreign Investor (D-8), a Resident (F-2), or a Permanent Resident (F-5)
※ The household assistant must have been employed for at least 1 year by the same foreign investor in other countries.

### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A Foreign Investment Notification form (A certified copy of unabridged Corporate Register or a copy of Business Registration Certificate ) or A copy of Certificate of FDI Company Registration
※ If you are a visa holder of Business Venture (D-8-2) and Technology and Business Startup (D-8-4), Business venture confirmation or a prospective venture confirmation
※ If you are a visa holder of Business Startup (D-8-4), you must submit documents proving industrial property rights and other certificates to prove the rights to technology and other copyrights
③ An employer's proof of employment (i.e. certificate of identification)
④ A document proving the income status of the employer
- A receipt for earned income tax withholding, certificate of income amount, payslip, a copy of an applicant's bankbook
※ The employer's income should be three times more than the gross national income (GNI) of the previous year announced by the Bank of Korea
⑤ Employment contract of household assistant
⑥ A letter of guarantee
⑦ A document proving a level of education of the household employee
⑧ A document proving that the household assistant has been hired by the employer for at least one year
※ e.g. employment contract, payslip, a copy of bankbook

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A household assistant of a foreign investor(CEO or executives) who has invested more than $500,000 and acquired status of stay of a Corporate/Foreign Investor (D-8), a Resident (F-2), or a Permanent Resident (F-5)

※ A household assistant who is hired abroad for at least 1 year can apply a visa to a Korean diplomatic mission abroad.

### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② A Foreign Investment Notification form (A certified copy of unabridged Corporate Register or a copy of Business Registration Certificate ) or a copy of Certificate of FDI Company Registration
※ If you are a visa holder of Business Venture(D-8-2) and Technology and Business Startup(D-8-4), you must submit a business venture confirmation or prospective venture confirmation.
※ If you are a visa holder of Technology and Business Startup(D-8-4), you must submit documents proving you have obtained industrial property rights or other documents proving possession of technologies and right to use the technologies, etc.
③ A proof of employment of employer (A copy of ID)
④ A document proving the income status of the employer
- a receipt for earned income tax withholding, certificate of income amount, payslip, a copy of an applicant's bankbook
※ The income should be three times more than gross national income (GNI) of the previous year based on the Bank of Korea
⑤ A labor contract for a household assistant
⑥ A letter of guarantee
⑦ A document proving the level of education of a household assistant

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A household assistant of a foreign investor(CEO or executives) who has invested more than $500,000 and acquired status of stay of a Corporate/Foreign Investor (D-8), a Resident (F-2), or a Permanent Resident (F-5)

④ A document proving the income status of the employer
- a receipt for earned income tax withholding, certificate of income amount, payslip, a copy of an applicant's bankbook

⑤ A labor contract for a household assistant
⑥ A letter of guarantee

question: My husband is applying for an E-1 professor visa as an e-visa. Can I apply for an F-3-1 dependent visa as an e-visa too, and how many entries and how long a stay would I get?
reference: Yes. The spouse of an E-1 applicant is eligible for the F-3-1 e-visa, and a dependent family member is granted the same number of entries and length of stay as the principal applicant. The E-1 e-visa is single-entry with a stay of up to 1 year, so you would get a single-entry visa with a stay of up to 1 year.
answer: You are eligible to apply for this visa as a spouse of a Professor (E-1) visa applicant [1]. A dependent family member will be granted the same number of entries and the length of stay as a principal applicant [1].

1. A person dispatched from a foreign media firm (newspapers, broadcasting corporations, magazines or other form of media) who plans to engage in reporting or news coverage while staying in ROK
2. A journalist who plans to engage in reporting or news coverage in ROK on the basis of a contract with the foreign media outlet.
3. A Journalist dispatched from a foreign media firm (newspapers, broadcasting corporations, magazines, or other form of media) that has a branch office in ROK

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa, if you are

A journalist dispatched for news reporting and coverage by a foreign media outlet (newspapers, broadcasting corporations, magazines, or other foreign information media) that has a branch office in the ROK

### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A proof of overseas assignment or a proof of current employment status
③ A copy of permit to the establishment of a Korean branch or liaison office, or a document demonstrating foreign capitals flowing into a Korean branch office

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

passages.title: Visa guide: F-2-2 Underage children of Korean National
passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A minor child of Korean, or a child born from a marriage of which an either of parents is Korean (including de facto marriage) and recognized by the Minister of Justice of ROK

## Embassy visa application

### Embassy visa application — Case 1

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A foreign minor child of a Korean parent

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② Official documents proving that the applicant is a minor of a Korean national
③ Documents proving the relation between a Korean national and an underage child, and the relation of custodianship.
④ A letter of guarantee of a Korean father or mother who has custodianship (If your father or mother has another spouse or partner, you also need to submit the letter of guarantee of the spouse or partner.)
⑤ If you cannot prove a custodianship over the child, then you have to submit an agreement signed by a person with parental rights or by a patron who have the same nationality as the child (If the child does not have the person with parental rights or the patron, you have to submit official documents or authenticated certificates proving that you do not have the person with parental rights/the patron)

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.
For more details about Alien Registration, Visa extension, or etc., please visit Hi Korea website(www.hikorea.go.kr).

### Embassy visa application — Case 2

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A child born from a marital relationship (including the de facto marital relationship) between a foreigner and Korean

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② An invitation Letter
③ Documents proving the relation between a Korean national and a respective underage child
- Documents proving a biological relation such as the DNA test results or Birth Certificates
④ A letter of guarantee from your Korean father or mother

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

question: Can a real estate immigrant investor holding an investor visa work or study in Korea?
reference: Yes. They are free to work, study and engage in economic activities, but must not engage in speculative behaviour or sell or work in an industry that hinders public good and custom.
answer: When you have an investor visa, you are free to work, study, and involve in economic activities [1, 2, 3, 4]. However, you must not engage in any speculative behavior or sell or work in an industry that hinders public good and custom [1, 2, 3, 4].

passages.title: Korea Investment Immigration Center Real Estate Investor Scheme Guide
passages.snippet:
Investment Guide for Investors for the Real Estate Immigrant Investor Scheme This guide outlines relevant details for investors for the Immigrant Investor Scheme for Real Estate.
A. (Maintaining Investment Status) Please be warned that your status will be cancelled if you lease or sold the estate, or if your estate becomes foreclosed or is set up for mortgage.
* If you, in any case, fail to meet any of the investment requirements during your investment period, your alien registration will be cancelled, and you will not be able to continue your stay in Korea.
B. (Working or Engaging in Economic Activities) When you have an investor visa, you are free to work, study, and involve in economic activities, however, you must not engage in any speculative behavior or sell or work in an industry that hinders public good and custom.
C. (Re-entry Period) If you have done your alien registration already, you must come to Korea at least once within one year from the date of departure, otherwise, your alien registration will be cancelled.
D. (Extending the Period of Stay) You must come to Korea and get an extension from an immigration office BEFORE your visa expires, otherwise, your alien registration will be cancelled.
E. (Giving a Consent to the Use of Personal Information) Please note that, by laws, all agents who sell their real estate properties to others must check the lease status, mortgage, sale or foreclosure of their individual buyers and report to the Immigration Office every May and November.
F. (Other Remarks) For more information, please check our website at www.visa.go.kr or contact the Korea Investment Immigration Center (☏ 032-740-7888, 7788) and your jurisdictional immigration office.
As a real estate investor, I, (Investor's name), hereby consent that I have read and understood all of the information above, and I will abide by the rules.

passages.title: Visa guide: F-5-5 Big Investor
passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A foreign investor who has invested more than $500,000 U.S. dollars at the time of application for permanent residence and has employed more than five native Koreans as a full-time worker

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A foreign investor who has invested US$500,000 or more in accordance with the 「Foreign Investment Promotion Act」 and hired five or more Korean full-time workers

### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A copy of Certificate of FDI Company Registration
③ A letter of guarantee
④ A copy of Business Registration Certificate or a certified copy of unabridged Corporate Register
⑤ Receipts for Earned Income Tax Withholding (issued by a Tax Office) of at least 5 Korean employees or Certificate of Income Amount (issued by a Tax Office)

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

question: Which applications can be selected on the letter of attorney form for foreign real estate investors?
reference: Change of status of sojourn, extension of sojourn period, application for Confirmation of Visa Issuance, and pre-investigation.

신청인 Applicant 성명 Full Name 여권번호(외국인등록번호)
Passport No.(Alien Registration No.)
주소 Address 투자대상 Investment Project 투자시설 Investment Facility 개발업체 또는 분양업체 Development enterprise or Selling-in-lots enterprise 투자시설 소재지 Address of Investment Facility 투자예정 금액 Amount of Planned Investment Money 부동산등 자산투자 외국인에 대한 체류관리지침의 규정에 따라 본인의 체류허가 적합여부에 대하여 사전심사안내를 위와 같이 신청하며, 사후 사정변경 등으로 실제 체류허가 등 결정내용이 사전안내와 다르더라도 이의를 제기하지 않겠습니다.
Following regulations in sojourn administration guidelines of foreign investors, I request the pre-investigation of my sojourn suitability as it is written above, and will never raise objections even if the final decision is different from the result of pre-investigation due to condition changes in future.
Date: 년 YYYY 월 MM 일 DD장 신청인 Applicant :
(서명 또는 인)
(Sign or stamp)

사 전 심 사 결 과 事先审查结果
□ 적합 / □ 부적합 Approved Disapproved 확인자Confirmer (서명 또는 인)
(Sign or stamp)
유의사항 Matters to be attended to
1. 사전심사안내는 투자금액 등 투자요건을 갖추었을 경우 신청인에 대한 각종 체류허가 등 가능여부에 대하여 사전에 확인해주는 것이며, 실제로 체류허가를 결정하는 것은 아닙니다. Pre-investigation is only for checking possibilities of various sojourn related businesses in advance when the applicant satisfies investment conditions such as investment money. It does not make an actual decision about sojourn related businesses.
2. 사전심사안내를 받은 이후 국내법 위반 및 기타 사정변경 등이 있을 경우 실제 체류허가 등 신청 시에는 사전안내와 다르게 결정될 수 있습니다.
In case of violating domestic laws or other condition changes, your apply for sojourn related businesses can be decided in a different way other than pre-investigation.

question: From what date did the Ministry of Justice expand multiple-entry visa eligibility for nationals of New Southern Policy countries?
reference: From December 3, 2018.
answer: The Ministry of Justice expanded the eligibility for multiple entry visas starting from December 3, 2018 [1].

citations.title: Expansion of multiple entry visa issuance
citations.snippet:
- 1 -
□ The Ministry of Justice (Minister Park Sang-ki) announced that it will expand the eligibility for multiple entry visas starting from December 3, 2018 to revitalize people to people exchanges and to attract inbound tourists from the countries of New Southern Policy, by granting a multiple entry visa with validity of 10 years to professionals such as doctors, lawyers, etc. in the region.
○ The number of visitors between Korea and the countries of New Southern Policy is expected to surpass a record 10 million this year with the visitors from those countries to the ROK already rising 13.8% from the previous year as of end-October this year.
○ The Ministry has decided to expand the eligibility for multiple entry visas to provide expedited entry services to the nationals from the countries of New Southern Policy, and the measure comes at a time when inbound tourists from those countries under the President Moon’s new policy are steadily on the rise with the popularity of Hallyu
(Korean Wave) such as K-POP, etc.
□ Eligibility and details for the 10-year multiple visa issuance scheme are as follows.
○ A Short-Term General (C-3) multiple entry visa valid for 10 years will be granted, MOJ revises its visa rules to expand exchanges with countries of New Southern Policy
-Expansion of multiple entry visa issuance for nationals of Vietnam, Philippines, Indonesia, etc.

question: Under the Ministry of Justice's July 2015 measures after the MERS outbreak, what happened to the validity of single-entry visas issued between March 1 and June 30, 2015?
reference: Their validity was extended from three months to six months.
answer: The validity of single-entry visas issued before and after the MERS development (from March 1 to June 30, 2015) was extended from the current three months to six months [1, 2]. Persons subject to this extension are allowed to enter the Republic of Korea even after the visa expiration date [1, 2].

question: Which Korean embassies stopped issuing visa labels as of February 24, 2020?
reference: The Korean embassies in the United States, Japan and 24 European countries (Greece, Netherlands, Norway, Denmark, Germany, Romania, Belgium, Bulgaria, Serbia, Sweden, Switzerland, Spain, Slovakia, Ireland, United Kingdom, Austria, Italy, Czech Republic, Croatia, Portugal, Poland, France, Finland, Hungary).
answer: The Korean Embassies in the United States of America, Japan and 24 European Countries* no longer issue visa labels, as of 24th February, 2020 [1]. The 24 European countries are Greece, Netherlands, Norway, Denmark, Germany, Romania, Belgium, Bulgaria, Serbia, Sweden, Switzerland, Spain, Slovakia, Ireland, United Kingdom, Austria, Italy, Czech Republic, Croatia, Portugal, Poland, France, Finland, and Hungary [1].

citations.snippet:
Announcement of Label Free Visa Policy and Important Guidelines The Korean Embassies in the United States of America, Japan and 24 European Countries* no longer issue visa labels, as of 24th February, 2020.
* Europe (24 countries): Greece, Netherlands, Norway, Denmark, Germany, Romania, Belgium, Bulgaria, Serbia, Sweden, Switzerland, Spain, Slovakia, Ireland, United Kingdom, Austria, Italy, Czech Republic, Croatia, Portugal, Poland, France, Finland, Hungary
※ All Korean Embassies will stop issuing visa labels from 1st July, 2020.
When visa applications are approved, the Embassy will notify applicants of their visa details by issuing ‘Visa Grant Notice’. (Visa Application Center may issue the document on behalf of the Embassy). passages.title: Visa guide: B-2-2 Tourist / Transit (Jeju)
passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

Except for countries not permitted to enter without a visa as announced by the Minister of Justice according to the Special Act on The Establishment of Jeju Special Self-governing Province And The Development of Free International City, foreign nationals entering ports and airports in Jeju for the purpose of Tourism/Transit, etc. are allowed to enter without a visa.

#### Visa Free Entry Guide
Visa is a fundamental requirement to enter the Republic of Korea, and in principle, foreigners must have valid visas when they travel. However, those who fall under any of the following categories below are allowed to enter Korea without visas. (Article 7(2) of the Immigration Act)
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
Even if the foreigner has the valid visa or is subject to visa-free entry, he/she may be denied entry to the Republic of Korea if he's found inadmissible by an immigration officer at the port of entry.

## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)
### Tourists in transit to Third Countries (* Temporarily Suspended due to COVID-19)

#### 1. Eligible Applicants
-
Nationals of countries, except for the 24 xecluded countries (Syria, Sudan, Iran, Macedonia, Cuba, Republic Of Kosovo, Palestine, Afghanistan, Iraq, Nigeria, Ghana, Yemen, Gambia, Senegal, Bangladesh, Kyrgyzstan, Pakistan, Somalia, Uzbekistan, Nepal, Cameron, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, Egypt) that are not granted visa free entry into Korea.
-
(a) Persons who hold a visa to the United States(including Guam and Saipan), Canada, Australia, or New Zealand, who transit through Korea to enter the abovementioned countries; or (b) persons who stayed in and departed from one of the abovementioned countries and transit through Korea bound for the country of origin or a third country.
-
(a) Persons who hold a visa (or permanent residency) to at least one of the 30 European countires (Greece, Netherlands, Norway, Denmark, Germany, Latvia, Rumania, Luxemburg, Lithuania, Liechtenstein, Malta, Belgium, Sweden, Switzerland, Spain, Slovakia, Slovenia, Iceland, Ireland, Estonia, United Kingdom, Austria, Italy, Czech, Cyprus, Portugal, Poland, France, Finland, Hungary), who transit through Korea bound for one of the 30 European countries; or (b) persons who departed from one of the 30 European countries, transit through Korea bound for the country of origin or a third country.

#### 2. Requirements
-
Persons who hold a visa (re-entry permit, permanent residency, etc.) to enter the United States, Canada, Australia, or New Zealand (hereinafter referred to as “the four advanced countries”) and
-
1) who go to one of the four advanced countries in transit through Korea; or
-
2) who stay in one of the four advanced countries and take a direct flight from the country to Korea to go to a country of nationality or a third country.
-
Please be noted that:
-
- If you are a U.S. visa holder who transit through Korea and Saipan to reach the U.S. as the final destination, you are permitted to enter Korea without a visa. (However, if you depart from the U.S. and enter Korea via Saipan, you are not granted no-visa entry to Korea.)
-
- If you are a Chinese group tourist holding a group-tourist visa to Japan and meet certain requirements (e.g. using a travel agency that only attracts Chinese group tourists), you are permitted to enter Korea without a visa.
-
- If you hold an e-visa to Australia and a visa label is attached to your passport, you are permitted to enter Korea without a visa. However, if the label is not on your passport, you are granted no-visa entry only when you depart from Australia and transit through Korea.

#### 3. Condition of Permission
-
You have a confirmed onward flight ticket for departure within 30 days after entering Korea, in addition to having no record of criminal offence such as overstay in the countries mentioned above
-
You had not been denied entry into Korea, or had not been fined more than 5 million KRW or not have been forcibly evicted or received a deportation order for violation of law in the past 3 years preceding the date of entry
-
You stayed no more than 3 days in the country of transit or stopover. (But, Not applicable when the person is returning to the immediate previous point of departure(country of transit or stopover)
-
For hloders of U.S., Canada, Australia, or New Zealand e-visas, a visa sticker must be attached to the passport; if unattached, visa free entry will be applicable when departing from the 4 countries mentioned above bound for the country of origin or a third country.

question: In the Korea Visa Portal e-form, which two answers in the visit information section affect the visa application fee?
reference: The planned number of visits to Korea (fees are calculated based on it) and the expected duration of stay (fees differ between "more than 90 days" and "90 days or less").
